notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2618
notes.content:
[i]Happy Holidays everyone!! This update comes with a hefty amount of balance changes and an awesome AI takeover feature in case one of your allies accidentally drops from the game. This will be going live on Friday the 22nd, just in time for Xmas! As always, see below for the details and let us know if you find any bugs![/i]

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[b][u]Pilot Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Deadeye
[list][*]Kingbreaker
[list][*]Special move Release time decreased from 1200ms to 900ms[/list][/list][/list]
[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Skylance:
[list][*]Unlock level reduced from 4 to 3
[*]Cooldown increased from 40s to 80s
[*]Time to impact decreased from 2.3s to 1.4s
[*]Damage radius decreased from 12m to 8m
[*]Damage increased from 500 to 650
[*]Damage is no longer split among all enemies struck
[*]Damage now applies to ALL units including friendlies[/list]
[*]Assault Plasma:
[list][*]Attack Range increased from 15m to 19m
[*]Cast Range increased from 18m to 19m[/list]
[*]Regenerative Layering:
[list][*]Burst HP increased from 10 to 20 HP per stack
[*]Regen HP remains at 10 per stack[/list]
[*]Momentum Shifter:
[list][*]Spell no longer applies a Silence to its target[/list]
[*]Nanite Wall:
[list][*]Ammo speed changed from 40 to 40/45/50
[*]Wall width changed from 30m to 20/24/28[/list]
[*]Shredder Field:
[list][*]Now inflicts damage to ALL units including friendlies[/list]
[*]Scatter Laser:
[list][*]Ability damage increased from 76 / 100 / 133.3 / 133.3 / 133.3dps to 80 / 120 / 145 / 145 / 145dps
[*]Bonus damage reduction of enemy increased from 20% to 25%[/list]
[*]Scatter Blaster:
[list][*]AA damage increased from 100 / 110 / 120 / 130 / 140dps to 110 / 120 / 130 / 140 / 150dps
[*]AA attack range decreased from 22.5m to 20m
[*]Ability damage increased from -- / -- / 200 / 240 / 266.7dps to -- / -- / 300 / 350 / 375dps[/list]
[*]Zealot Drive:
[list][*]HP Regen increased from 4HP to 8HP per second[/list]
[*]Pulse Cannon:
[list][*]AA Range increased from 12m to 14m
[*]Ability cast range increased from 21m to 24m[/list]
[*]Atomic Welder:
[list][*]Ability AoE radius increased from 5m to 7m[/list]
[*]Napalm Canister:
[list][*]Speed bonus increased from 3.95 / 4.45 / 4.95 / 5.45 / 5.95 to 4.5 / 5.0 / 5.5 / 6.0 / 6.5
[*]Bonus damage against Slagged units increased from 2% to 4% per stack[/list]
[*]Compound Rifle:
[list][*]Bonus damage increased from -- / -- / 70 / 100 / 130 to -- / -- / 120 / 180 / 240[/list]
[*]Pinpoint Laser:
[list][*]Ability Damage increased from 200 to 325[/list]
[*]Polarity Blaster:
[list][*]Ability attack range increased from 35m to 37m[/list]
[*]Fade Shot:
[list][*]Cooldown reduced from 20s to 12s[/list]
[*]Healing Dome:
[list][*]Cooldown time increased from 45s to 50s[/list]
[*]Ion Cannon:
[list][*]Cast range decreased from 24m to 21m
[*]Ability damage increased from 125 to 175
[*]Ability AoE increased from 5m to 6m[/list]
[*]Sidewinder Frame:
[list][*]Ability damage bonus decreased from 25% to 20%
[*]Ability damage bonus duration decreased from 6s to 4s[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]AI "Take Control" Option
[list][*]It’s been a long time coming, but it is now possible to gain control of the AI rigs that take over for any teammate that leaves the match prematurely 
[list][*]The moment a teammate leaves or disconnects from the game, simply click on the rig that is now controlled by the AI and look at the Inspection Window in the upper-right corner. Click the “Take Control” button and voila, that rig is added to your Command Grid!
[*]Only one player can take control of an AI rig. There is no sharing
[*]When you take control, your rig selection will immediately switch to the rig you gained control of
[*]This can be used in Solo skirmishes as well, if you want to ease into 2rig or 3rig control without committing to a full 15 minutes of micro multitasking[/list][/list][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue that caused Day of the Dead Fury’s Regenerative Layering from not dealing its burst heal before the heal regen (already hotfixed in shortly after the release of 2572)
[*]Fixed an issue where Regenerative Layering was not showing its cooldown state in the Command Grid
[*]Fixed an issue where Steam Powered Pandora’s Skylance was not giving preview sight of target location when Skylance was launched
[*]Fixed an issue where the hover-over pilot portrait status next to the scoreboard was not updating in real-time.
[*]Fixed an issue where Healing Dome was healing outside the boundaries of the dome FX by 1.5m[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Crazed Banshee is not triggering General Vex’s damage buff passive. A fix is being worked on[/list]

[i]Alright! So there you have! A lot of changes for the holiday season, hopefully enough to tide you over while we continue to work on the bigger changes, slowly but surely. ;)

Remember to post feedback or any bugs on the forums!

Thanks everyone![/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2572
notes.content:
[i]GREETINGS and HAPPY HALLOWEEN! Just a very minor update to prepare things for the Halloween celebration event being hosted by our loving fanbase Dropzone Nation! See below for all the details and don't forget to tune in to twitch.tv/dropzonenation at 1:00pm EDT to watch the stream, play some games, and win some Halloween crates! Patch is landing today, October 31st, in an hour or so![/i]

[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Surprise, surprise! Day of the Dead Fury has been added to the Halloween crate! Alongside Zombie Vanguard from the last update you will now be able to get these items when purchasing our Halloween crate:
[list][*]Day of the Dead Fury gear skins
[list][*]Assault Plasma
[*]Regenerative Layering
[*]Battle Cry
[*]Stunning Entry (Automatically given when you collect and equip the Weapon, Body, and Utility)[/list]
[*]Day of the Dead Fury avatar[/list]
[*]Redemption Codes
[list][*]On the Collections page there is now a "Redeem Code" tab
[*]In this interface you simple input your code, with dashes, to receive whatever free item you have won[/list][/list]

[i]Alright! Told you that would be a quick one! See you all at the event! 

Happy Halloween![/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2560 (Halloween Crate Edition! One FREE!)
notes.content:
[i]GREETINGS COMMANDERS! It has been quite awhile since our last update and for that we apologize! We're hoping this patch makes up for it, releasing October 18th/19th (depending on your time zone)! We're very excited to give you a big sweep of balance changes, gameplay additions to objective points, a new Overtime rule, and of course... our very first Vanity crate feature everyone's favorite upcoming holiday, HALLOWEEN! Check all the details below and post in the comments if you have any questions![/i]

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Objective Escalation
[list][*]All three objectives now have a second tier available to complete after the first tier is taken.
[*]There is a 60 second timer after the Tier 1 objective is completed, allowing you and/or your team members time to strategize on how you want to complete the next objective
[*]Once an objective is taken, any current progress on that objective is wiped clean
[*]Tier 1 and 2 adjustment/changes:
[list][*]Total Vision:
[list][*]Points earned – 1/2[/list]
[*]Alpha Strike:
[list][*]Points earned – 2/4
[*]Kills required – 3/5[/list]
[*]Boss Slayer:
[list][*]Points earned – 2/4
[*]Kills required – 1/3[/list]
[*]Max Eradicate:
[list][*]Points earned – 2/4
[*]Kills required – 125/175[/list][/list][/list]
[*]Overtime Hive Surge
[list][*]After 60 seconds of Overtime, all completely destroyed Hives will respawn at level 1 to increase the chance of core uplinking[/list][/list]
[b][u]Pilot Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Pilot: General Vex
[list][*]Using abilities now also grants her a short ability damage buff
[list][*]+7.5% ability damage for 3s[/list][/list]
[*]Pilot: Widget
[list][*]Rapid Repairs
[list][*]Will no longer heal Widget herself unless there are no allied rigs nearby to heal[/list][/list][/list]
[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Quantum Mire
[list][*]The damage dealt by Mire is now governed by a spell on the affected units rather than by splash damage.
[*]This means it now operates similar to Repair Bubble and follows normal spell stacking rules, so it won’t stack with itself when cast from multiple sources.
[*]As a consequence of the new setup, % based ability damage bonuses will now work with Quantum Mire[/list]
[*]Plasma Drone
[list][*]HP from 160 to 150
[*]Explosion damage from 100 to 50
[*]Explosion slow strength from 33 to 25%[/list]
[*]Replicating Rifle
[list][*]Summon’s ability DPS from 40/50/60/65/70 to 40/45/50/55/60
[*]Summon’s HP from 160 to 150[/list]
[*]Cloning Laser
[list][*]Auto-attack range increased to 24[/list]
[*]Lapse Generator
[list][*]Auto-attack range increased to 24[/list]
[*]Gravity Gun
[list][*]Auto-attack range increased to 24[/list]
[*]Shredder Field
[list][*]Damage per second rescaled from 70/90/100 to 60/80/100[/list]
[*]Thresher Flail
[list][*]Ability damage lowered from 135 DPS to 120 DPS (from 45 damage per tick to 40)
[*]Cooldown reduced from 28/24/20/16/12 to 24/21/18/15/12[/list]
[*]Black Hole Shell
[list][*]Cooldown from 45 to 30s
[*]The Tank now gains a buff when BHS concludes
[*]The buff gains strength depending on how much damage the Tank took during BHS
[*]For every 4% of max HP lost, the Tank gains 1 buff stack (maxing out at 10 stacks)
[*]The buff lasts 4s
[*]Each stack grants +0.5 m/s and 5% auto-attack damage[/list]
[*]Sludge Tanks
[list][*]Cooldown from 36 to 28s[/list]
[*]Frequency Adaptation
[list][*]Base speed from 3.4 m/s to 3.55
[*]Armor buff duration from 4.0s to 2.0s
[*]Armor buff max stacks from 4/6/8 to 6/8/10[/list]
[*]Grav Engine
[list][*]Base speed from 3.0 to 3.2
[*]Cooldown from 26s to 24s[/list]
[*]Evoker’s Web
[list][*]Search Range lowered from 30m to 20m
[*]Will now also display a ranging decal on mouseover[/list]
[*]Skylance
[list][*]Damage from 850 to 500
[*]Cooldown from 100 to 40
[*]Damage is now divided evenly across all targets hit by the ability
[*]The splash decal on the ground announcing the missile now grants a small amount of vision, to better sell the suspense and payoff of the missile landing[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Halloween has come to Europa! (err… Europaween??)
[list][*]To help celebrate the event we have added our very first vanity crate to the crate Shop and every single player that logs in for the month of October will get ONE FREE Halloween vanity crate! Just visit the shop and claim it!
[*]We've filled it with a variety of unique and spoopy items like:
[list][*]Zombie Vanguard gear skins
[list][*]Scatter Laser
[*]Thrusters
[*]Zealot Drive
[*]Angel of Mercy (Automatically given when you collect and equip the Weapon, Body, and Utility)[/list]
[*]Halloween Uplink Animation and Sounds
[*]Halloween Avatars
[*]Halloween Vision Towers[/list]
[*][b]Important note:[/b] It is [u]impossible[/u] to get duplicates with Vanity crates! So the good news is once you purchase the crate and receive your item, the next time you purchase the crate you’re guaranteed to get a different item from the crate![/list]
[*]Custom Uplink Animations
[list][*]There is now an Uplink section in the Collections menu. Simply select which uplink you want to use (if you have one of the new custom ones), and that uplink will play in-game for everyone playing, not just you! (only if you are the one uploading of course)[/list]
[*]Rename Tokens are finally here!
[list][*]Purchasing a token is as easy as navigating to the Account Settings section of your Player Profile and clicking purchase
[*]Once you have a token, simply enter the new name you want and click Save Name[/list]
[*]The Crate counter in the upper right of the Home Scene will now say “Buy Crates” instead of “0 Crates”. Clicking this button in this state will take you directly to the Crate Shop
[*]Kill banners have been added for single rig kills
[*]Dropship avatar packages have been sent to all our Dropship retweeters![/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Velocity Ramp disengaged when your rig was around a friendly totem like plasma drone or turret
[*]Fixed an issue where any non-rig unit that had less than 1HP of health was displaying as having 0HP. They will now show 1HP instead
[*]Fixed an issue where Gravity Gun’s ability damage was not being applied to enemy’s that were not affected by the pull: Hives and Bosses[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Crazed Banshee is not triggering General Vex’s damage buff passive. A fix is being worked on[/list]

[i]Whew! What a mouthful! Please let us know if you find any bugs with the new Vanity crate, and of course give us your feedback on the new balance changes and objective gameplay additions. Also, keep an eye out for a special surprise next week. We love Halloween and we're not done being spoopy! ;)

Thanks everyone![/i]

[*]Once you have a token, simply enter the new name you want and click Save Name[/list]
[*]The Crate counter in the upper right of the Home Scene will now say “Buy Crates” instead of “0 Crates”. Clicking this button in this state will take you directly to the Crate Shop
[*]Kill banners have been added for single rig kills
[*]Dropship avatar packages have been sent to all our Dropship retweeters![/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Velocity Ramp disengaged when your rig was around a friendly totem like plasma drone or turret
[*]Fixed an issue where any non-rig unit that had less than 1HP of health was displaying as having 0HP. They will now show 1HP instead
[*]Fixed an issue where Gravity Gun’s ability damage was not being applied to enemy’s that were not affected by the pull: Hives and Bosses[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Crazed Banshee is not triggering General Vex’s damage buff passive. A fix is being worked on[/list]

[i]Whew! What a mouthful! Please let us know if you find any bugs with the new Vanity crate, and of course give us your feedback on the new balance changes and objective gameplay additions. Also, keep an eye out for a special surprise next week. We love Halloween and we're not done being spoopy! ;)

Thanks everyone![/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2448
notes.content:
[i]Hello Core hunters! This week's patch will release August 16th. We have some quality of life changes and some fixes, but most importantly we have added a 'Consent to Transfer' message/setting for all current players. You can follow this link for all the details as to why we have done this:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/572520/announcements/detail/1446072699608079271] Change of Publisher[/url]

If you have any question about this please do not hesitate to post in the thread or message me directly if you see me in-game. Thanks everyone![/i]


[h1]Message to All Players[/h1]
[list][*]'Consent to Transfer' message and user interface has been added
[list][*]On September 6th, 2017, Gameforge will be relinquishing its role as publisher of Dropzone and handing the game over to its developers, Sparkypants
[*]All items, game progress and unlocked content remain yours
[*]If you click ‘Yes’ during the popup message your Steam ID and account name will be transferred from Gameforge to Sparkypants
[*]If you click ‘No’ your account details will not be transferred to Sparkypants and you will have to create a new game account if you want to play Dropzone again
[*]If you wish to change your mind, you can do this at any time from the Account Settings menu in the Player Profile section of the game until the September 6th transfer[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]You can now mute individual teammates via the “Show Stats” hotkey menu
[*]The Watch menu filter now remembers the previous search parameters when loading back in
[*]The Friends list is now anchored to the very right of the Main Menu. In situations where a lower resolution still causes overlap of the Friends list and the Global Chat window, there is now proper z-indexing to bring forward the window you have clicked on[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where entering siege mode would clear your current target when it should not have
[*]Fixed an issue where the Rewards Screen would not show up after the Post-Match Results Screen due to a player disconnecting and then reconnecting
[*]Fixed an issue where team coloring during Replays was incorrectly using yellow-green for the right-side team
[*]Fixed an issue where deselecting a rig would break the UI and HUD for observers during Live games and/or Replays
[*]Fixed an issue where the details UI of the replay list would break if you re-entered the Watch menu with the “Show Spoilers” checkbox ticked
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause the Match Seek timer to continue running, falsely, if you left a party after returning to the Main Menu together from a completed match
[*]Various localization fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Due to the new leveling system, older replays will be using observer information that is out of date. A replay wipe will be in the near future, so we suggest video capturing any replays you would like to save[/list]

[i]So there you have it everyone. Plenty more is in store for Dropzone in the future, and pretty soon Sniper 3 will be available for everyone! Thanks as always and let us know if you catch any bugs we missed!![/i]

notes.title: Change of Publisher
notes.content:
On September 6th, 2017, Gameforge will be relinquishing its role as publisher of Dropzone and handing the game over to its developers, Sparkypants.

This will not change anything for you – all items, game progress and unlocked content remain yours.

In order to continue playing with your account, we need to receive consent to transfer your account details to Sparkypants by September 6th.

From August 16th, a window will open when you launch Dropzone in which you can provide consent to transfer your account details with a single click. This window will appear only once.

Simply click on ‘Yes’ and your Steam ID and account name will be transferred from Gameforge to Sparkypants.
 
We will not transfer your data if you do not so wish. Simply click on ‘No’ if that is the case. Your account details will not be transferred to Sparkypants and you will have to create a new game account if you want to play Dropzone again.

Please note:
[list][*]If you wish to change your mind, you can do this at any time from the profile account settings menu in the game until the September 6th transfer.
[*]Sparkypants are based in the USA and therefore different privacy laws apply.
[*]If you do not agree to the transfer, your details will be deleted on September 6th. All previous game progress will be lost. If you wish to continue playing Dropzone afterwards, you will have to create a new account.
[*]On September 6th, we will need to carry out extensive maintenance, during which time the servers will likely be offline for several hours. Of course, we will try to keep this downtime to a minimum.[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2398
notes.content:
[i]Hello Europans and everyone beyond the belt! This week's patch will release August 2nd. Some HUD improvements, a few balance changes, and a big overhaul of the custom lobby system. Check out all the details below![/i]

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Dead Rig Command Grid
[list][*]The Command Grid is now fully interactable even when your rigs are dead
[list][*]Upgrade your rigs via mouse click or hotkeys (ALT + Q, W, E)
[*]Hover over gear and software icons to see their information card (Hold down ALT to expand their details)
[*]Give your teammates information about your health/respawn time remaining by ALT + Left Mouse clicking on your pilot portrait and/or tab[/list][/list][/list]
[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Hydraulic Pins
[list][*]Base HP lowered from 400 to 250[/list]
[*]Momentum Shifter
[list][*]Base speed lowered from 4 to 3 m/s[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Custom Lobby now supports variable rigs per player
[list][*]This change replicates what players are able to seek for in the Quickmatch queue
[*]Only the Host of the lobby can adjust the amount of rigs the other players use
[*]Next to each name is a Dropmark icon that rotates when clicked. The number of red dots indicates how many rigs that player controls
[*]The size of the player slot will automatically adjust based on the number of rigs that player is controlling[/list]
[*]The level cap restriction for Ranked Draft in Custom Lobbies has been lifted
[list][*]1v1 (3 Rig control per player) no longer requires level 10 but still requires owning 6 pilots 
[*]3v3 (1 Rig control per player) no longer requires level 5[/list]
[*]Dead rigs will now have a “skull and crossbones” overlay on their pilot portrait in the Command Grid
[*]The 4th “Ranked Squad” slot in the Builder is now a normal slot that can be selected and renamed[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue that prevented players from utilizing the Ranked Draft option in a 6 player (3v3) Custom Lobby game
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the uplink SFX, VFX, and HUD animations to continue if a rig was killed during the uploading process
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Shrapnel’s profile quote to be “null”
[*]Various localization fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Due to the new leveling system, older replays will be using observer information that is out of date. A replay wipe will be in the near future, so we suggest video capturing any replays you would like to save[/list]

[i]So there you have it everyone. Let us know if you catch any bugs we missed in the Custom Lobby changes, and keep your feedback coming!

Thanks![/i]

[list][*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty

[list][*]AOE lowered from 30m to 20m[/list]

[list][*]Ability damage at level 5 lowered from 500 to 450[/list]
[*]Predator
[list][*]Damage bonus lowered from 20% to 15%[/list]

[list][*]Speed per stack lowered from 1.5% to 1.25%[/list]

[list][*]This release will default the selection to 1 Rig as most players play with 1 Rig

[*]Hovering over a pilot in the Builder now shows their animated full portrait
[*]The Watch menu has been updated to include “Unranked”, “1v1 Ranked”, and “3v3 Ranked”
[*]Team vs Team in Custom Lobby now has “Ranked Style Draft” support
[*]Boss Buff effect around and above the rig has been updated
[*]Status effect icons at the top of the Command Grid have been tweaked
[*]Small polish tweaks to the Command Grid have been added[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where leaving the Draft was not queue penalizing players
[*]Fixed an issue where the Mastery data record system for 1 Rig and 3 Rig was inverted
[*]Fixed an issue where Turbine’s Special Move was only reducing his health by 4HP/sec instead of 22HP/sec
[*]Fixed an issue where Surge Amplifier was not triggering Cortex’s passive
[*]Fixed an issue where using Paradigm Shift on a flying Sniper while over a chasm would render the Sniper stuck
[*]Fixed an issue where Hives that were casting spells where not maintaining the aggro of its target during the full spell cast
[*]Fixed an issue where Infestation waves would start and end within a second or two if the user was idle
[*]Fixed an issue where the Boss’s chain-lightning attack was attacking enemies outside of its range
[*]Fixed an issue where Laser Lens was doing no damage if the projectile was released and the rig was killed before the projectile impacted the enemy
[*]Fixed an issue where the gear card for Atomic Welder did not state that it heals 5HP per slag stack
[*]Fixed an issue where hitting ESCAPE as the Watch menu was loading would overlay the Main Menu on top of the Watch screen and eventually in Draft
[*]Fixed an issue where AFK or Abandoning players were unable to chat in post-match results chat. We allow this to give a player a chance to explain themselves if desired
[*]Fixed an issue where Solo matches that were interrupted and auto-saved, where no getting accurate gear level data sent to them when resuming the saved game
[*]Fixed an issue where the new HUD was not being hidden properly in Replays when unticking the HUD checkbox or when holding down the [U] hotkey
[*]Various localization fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Due to the new leveling system, older replays will be using observer information that is out of date. A replay wipe will be in the near future, so we suggest video capturing any replays you would like to save[/list]

[i]So there it is! Lots of juicy changes and a bunch of new gear with our newest Sniper. Remember, Sniper 3 comes out pretty soon as well so be on the lookout.

As always, please let us know what you think of these changes/additions and if you have any bugs or balance feedback, post about it in the Steam forums or on the Dropzone Nation discord. We love hearing from you all

See you on Europa, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2318
notes.content:
[i]Greetings Europa! This week's patch will release on July 5th. It's a relatively light one, but there are some nice nuggets for you.

Also... we recently received a broken transmission in the clear. It's very garbled and missing some data. We have our team working to clean it up, but the one word we have been able to understand so far is.... "shrapnel". Could be a distress signal, could be a debris clean-up crew. Unsure at the moment. We will keep you posted when we know more.

For now, here are the patch notes for Wednesday's release![/i]


[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Test Loadout Sandbox now supports unowned pilots
[list][*]One of your biggest request is finally available!
[*]Simply click on any unowned pilot in the Builder to add that pilot to your dropship, then click Test Loadout and you’ll be taken to the Sandbox where you can use their default gear to get a feel for them before purchasing
[*]You cannot “Save” your loadout when you have an unowned pilot on your dropship[/list]
[*]Sideboards for Ranked play have been removed from the game
[list][*]This change is in direct response to Sideboards not fulfilling a balance function for counter-picking pilots
[*]This removal is also preparation for a different change coming in a few weeks that will address the counter-picking that players will be doing for Ranked matches, now that the new leveling system is gear-focused instead of rig-focused
[*]Any gear contained in your sideboard will automatically be returned to your inventory
[*]Ranked play is still gated at player level 10 and needing to own 6 pilots[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Revamped in-game HUD and Builder UI (WIP)
[list][*]To go along with last week’s in-game leveling changes we have slightly modified our in-game HUD to be sleeker and more screen-space efficient:
[list][*]Squad level and Squad XP bar are shown in upper left and right corners, directly next to the new team banner, as well as directly underneath the new Command Grid
[*]Team banners now replace having three player icons stacked per side
[*]The scoreboard is the new location for the main overview information of all 6 pilots in the match. Respawn timers are visible for all 6, but health bars are only visible for your own team. Hovering over your teammates gives you their gear unlock/cooldown status
[*]The Command Grid has been rearranged and is still WIP. When playing 3rig control (1v1 style) you’ll have an extra set of buttons on the left side of the Command Grid to cycle through your three rigs via tab, or mouse click
[*]The Inspection Window has also been given a slight redesign[/list]
[*]Builder UI changes
[list][*]Gear/Software tabs have been added to the Gear window. Clicking on the tabs will automatically move the slot selection on the Builder Command Grid to the corresponding gear/software category for easier equipping
[*]“Test Loadout” and “Save Loadout” buttons are now placed under the Pilot list[/list][/list][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Surrender UI was not scaled properly for 4k resolution
[*]Fixed an issue where chat messages from Draft were overlapping new chat messages once the game began
[*]Fixed an issue where the Inspection Window was appearing on mouse button down, instead of mouse button up
[*]Minor localization fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Due to the new leveling system, older replays will be using observer information that is out of date. A replay wipe will be in the near future, so we suggest video capturing any replays you would like to save[/list]

[i]That about wraps up this week's changes! Thanks for reading and as always give us your feedback in the forums!

See you in the drift, Commanders.[/i]

[*]This removal is also preparation for a different change coming in a few weeks that will address the counter-picking that players will be doing for Ranked matches, now that the new leveling system is gear-focused instead of rig-focused
[*]Any gear contained in your sideboard will automatically be returned to your inventory
[*]Ranked play is still gated at player level 10 and needing to own 6 pilots[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Revamped in-game HUD and Builder UI (WIP)
[list][*]To go along with last week’s in-game leveling changes we have slightly modified our in-game HUD to be sleeker and more screen-space efficient:
[list][*]Squad level and Squad XP bar are shown in upper left and right corners, directly next to the new team banner, as well as directly underneath the new Command Grid
[*]Team banners now replace having three player icons stacked per side
[*]The scoreboard is the new location for the main overview information of all 6 pilots in the match. Respawn timers are visible for all 6, but health bars are only visible for your own team. Hovering over your teammates gives you their gear unlock/cooldown status
[*]The Command Grid has been rearranged and is still WIP. When playing 3rig control (1v1 style) you’ll have an extra set of buttons on the left side of the Command Grid to cycle through your three rigs via tab, or mouse click
[*]The Inspection Window has also been given a slight redesign[/list]
[*]Builder UI changes
[list][*]Gear/Software tabs have been added to the Gear window. Clicking on the tabs will automatically move the slot selection on the Builder Command Grid to the corresponding gear/software category for easier equipping
[*]“Test Loadout” and “Save Loadout” buttons are now placed under the Pilot list[/list][/list][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Surrender UI was not scaled properly for 4k resolution
[*]Fixed an issue where chat messages from Draft were overlapping new chat messages once the game began
[*]Fixed an issue where the Inspection Window was appearing on mouse button down, instead of mouse button up
[*]Minor localization fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Due to the new leveling system, older replays will be using observer information that is out of date. A replay wipe will be in the near future, so we suggest video capturing any replays you would like to save[/list]

[i]That about wraps up this week's changes! Thanks for reading and as always give us your feedback in the forums!

See you in the drift, Commanders.[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2301
notes.content:
[i]It's been awhile, Commanders! We are happy to report this week's patch will deploy on [b]Wednesday, June 28[/b], and boy is this a big one. We have a [b]SIGNIFICANT[/b] change to the way our in-game leveling works, so please read the details and give us your feedback once you start playing a good amount of matches with it![/i]

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]New Rig/Gear Leveling System
[list][*]To the bridge the gap between 1v1 and 3v3 play styles we have made a comprehensive overhaul to the way players use their level-up points for upgrading:
[list][*]1v1 and 3v3 will now use the same rule set
[*]Players can now reach Squad level 15 in all game modes
[*]Rigs no longer have a personal upgrade level, but share the total Squad level
[*]Respawn times are now tied to the Squad level, starting at 30s and scaling to 50s
[*]When you gain a squad level you get one point to spend on each rig you control
[*]Points are spent on the individual active gears of each rig, instead of the rig as a whole
[*]ALT + 1, 2, 3 are still viable shortcuts for quick upgrading, but now follows a lowest-to-highest, left-to-right upgrade order
[*]ALT + Q, W, E are additional shortcuts added to quick upgrade the specific gear slot you want to put a level-up point into 
[*]Each gears’ unlock level determines how many points are spent in that gear slot to unlock it
[*]Each gear slot, locked or unlocked, provides stat bonuses per upgrade, as seen by a “[STAT] UP!” bubble text above the Command Grid. Spending points on gears that are already unlocked provides extra stat bonuses of that slot:
[list][*]Weapon Slot = DPS 
[list][*]DPS used to scale with rig level, but now scales with points spent in the Weapon slot[/list]
[*]Body Slot = HP
[list][*]HP used to scale with rig level, but now scales with points spent in the Body slot[/list]
[*]Utility Slot = SPD
[list][*]SPD did not previously scale with rig level, but now scales with points spent in the Utility slot, making rigs faster than ever before[/list][/list]
[*]All Special Moves unlock at Squad Level 10
[*]All software is unlocked at level 1 and level scaling has been removed
[*]All software has been reworked to adjust for this change. Please see details below in the Gear Changes section[/list]
[*]This is a huge shift in the way we want players to approach their strategy before and during the battle
[*]This change puts focus on the gear itself, when to unlock it and why, and also this put focus on what kind of stat buff you want to put into your rigs as you play, depending on the changing needs of the battle
[*]We understand this is a huge difference from the way Dropzone has normally been played and we look forward to all your feedback on this new style of upgrading[/list]
[*]3v3 Ranked
[list][*]3v3 Ranked now allows parties to match with parties/non-parties of different sizes
[list][*]Any combination totaling no more than 6 players will properly match, except for three parties of 2, as we do not want to divide up a party to complete a match[/list][/list]
[*]Inspection Window
[list][*]Players can now left-click on any Kavash, friendly/enemy rig, or summoned unit to see all statistical information for that unit, including but not limited to HP, Armor, and buff/de-buff statuses
[*]This information is only updated if the player has vision of the unit that is clicked on. Old information will persist if the selection is on a unit that is out of vision
[*]Left-clicking anywhere else on the map will close the Inspection Window[/list]
[*]Onboarding missions have been slightly reworked to account for the new leveling system[/list]

[b][u]Pilot Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Cortex:
[list][*]Default Sensor SW has changed from Intelligence Grid to Hive Imaging[/list]
[*]General Vex:
[list][*]Default Sensor SW has changed from Intelligence Grid to Satellite Network
[*]Default Propulsion SW has been changed from Velocity Ramp to Turbo Pistons[/list][/list]

[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Combat Rush
[list][*]Auto-attack damage bonus switched to 2% per stack rather than a flat damage bonus[/list]
[*]Frag Rounds
[list][*]Increased the explosion damage from 35 to 50 to be a little more competitive w/ Inferno Rounds[/list]
[*]Plated Conduits
[list][*]Armor from +5 to +3[/list]
[*]Radar Mapping
[list][*]Removed scaling, base sight range bonus from +15 to +30[/list]
[*]Resolute Stand
[list][*]HP Regen increased from 2.5% to 3.5%[/list]
[*]Logic Rerouter
[list][*]Lowered base CD from 40s to 30s and removed scaling[/list]
[*]Linked Sensors
[list][*]Base sight range bonus from 10m to 15m[/list]
[*]Isolation Suite
[list][*]Increased bonus armor vs Kavash from +7 to +9, removed HP bonus[/list]
[*]Robust Circuits
[list][*]Removed scaling. Now grants a flat +150 HP bonus[/list]
[*]Heart of the Pack
[list][*]Now triggers on Rig/Hive/Alpha/Boss kills rather than just Alpha kills[/list]
[*]Velocity Ramp
[list][*]Now grants bonus speed when there are no other rigs nearby[/list]
[*]Reinforced Circuits
[list][*]Now grants the Rig bonus armor when it is at or below 33% health[/list]
[*]Satellite Network
[list][*]Grants the Rig vision of Cores on the ground[/list]
[*]Intelligence Grid
[list][*]Grants the Rig temporary vision of a random enemy Rig every 15s[/list]
[*]Emissive Controller
[list][*]Now grants a permanent +SPD bonus on Rig/Hive/Alpha/Boss kills, similar to Amoeba Protocol[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Two additional “First Time Ever” penalty tiers have been added:
[list][*]First offense ever gives you a message warning you that repeated offenses will increase your penalty
[*]Second offense ever gives you a 2 minute queue penalty
[*]Once these are both triggered all future offenses will be met with the already known Daily penalty tier[/list]
[*]Holding down ALT when viewing a gear card will expand it to a more robust informational mode
[*]The Test Loadout Sandbox now has a Jump Pad and an Uplink. Alpha position has been shifted
[*]Game Action Updates field no longer displays level-up or uplink complete statuses
[*]Metin 2 Promotional tab has been removed for all players who did not achieve level 10 before the promotion had completed
[*]Gear card backgrounds are now more opaque, for ease of reading
[*]Quickmatch checkboxes and labels now have a larger hit area, making them easier to click
[*]Some additional hover-over SFX have been added to the Masteries page
[*]The Boss power-up icon and Boss buff FX have been visually updated[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where party members were seeing their local game mode and region selection instead of the game mode and region selected by the party member who initiated the match seek
[*]Fixed issue where an AI-controlled Pandora would use Litany of Plagues on her own friendly summoned units
[*]Fixed an issue where the attack range of Plutus’ Lapse Generator was 17.5m instead of 20m, like normal Lapse Generator
[*]Fixed an issue where the Sniper’s walk animation failed to loop after rig was stunned
[*]Fixed an issue where the Health pickup in Emergency Evac did not loop its animation properly
[*]Fixed an issue where the minimap's camera-view trapezoid on Styx was missing its bottom line
[*]Fixed an error message that would appear when attempting to seek a match while partying with a player that was under a seeking penalty
[*]Fixed an issue where Snipers transforming from Flight to Walk mode while hovering over a Jump Pad would not burn their transformation cooldown
[*]Fixed an issue where the Jump Pads in STYX would play their launch SFX twice
[*]Fixed an issue where in-game music would randomly stop and not play the next track
[*]Fixed an issue where Kavash health bars at full health were not showing slagged status
[*]Fixed an issue where the hover-text for Alpha Strike was stating the objective was worth 2 points instead of the normal 4
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3rd player of a team was not getting proper visual feedback when calling or participating in a Surrender vote
[*]Fixed an issue where Custom Lobby members would still appear in the lobby if they ALT-F4ed out of the game
[*]Fixed an issue were it was possible to start Custom Lobby game with an offline player in the lobby
[*]Fixed an issue where creating a Custom Lobby, then clicking Exit Game did not destroy the lobby
[*]Fixed an issue where the Landfall SFX would play twice if Landfall was interrupted just before it took off
[*]Fixed an issue where no artwork or scenario name was displayed for the loading screen if you clicked Retry for Emergency Evac I
[*]Fixed an issue where changing your Player icon did not immediately update for the Match Rewards screen
[*]Fixed an issue where the ambient SFX for STYX would still play even if Dropzone was not the top window
[*]Minor localization fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Due to the new leveling system, older replays will be using observer information that is out of date. A replay wipe will be in the near future, so we suggest video capturing any replays you would like to save[/list]

[i]That's it for this week everyone. Let us know what you think in the forums and remember, Snipers 2 and 3 are less than a month away!

See ya, belters![/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2267
notes.content:
Commanders, this week's patch will deploy on [b]Wednesday, June 14[/b].

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Queue Penalty Improvements
[list][*]Abandon and Surrender options have been added to the in-game options menu
[*]Getting kicked from a game due to AFK detection, disconnecting from a game, and choosing the abandon option in a match with 2+ human players is considered toxic behavior and will be subject to a queue penalty
[*]Gracefully resigning, Team Surrender, and choosing to resign in matches with one remaining human player on the team is considered acceptable behavior and will not be met with a penalty
[/list][*]Surrendering
[list][*]Surrender voting replaces Resign in matches with more than one human player on the same team. If a vote passes, all players on that team concede the match and the match ends. The player who calls the vote is automatically voted 'for' surrender. Players who call a vote cannot call another vote for 5 minutes
[*]After Minute Y (5+ min), a team can vote to surrender, both in ranked and unranked. Voting is counted among all connected humans players on the team, abstaining from the vote counts as 'don't surrender'. The vote must be unanimous to pass
[*]After Minute Z (10+ min) a surrender vote can be passed with a majority vote, instead of a unanimous vote
[*]Gracefully resigning treats AI teammates as a non-vote
[/list][*]Achievements
[list][*]To address the recent change where Achievements can no longer be earned in Custom Lobby or Challenge matches, the 2v2 specific achievements have been changed
[*]Double Humiliation
[list][*]This achievement is now called Humiliation
[*]The new achievement objective is to team Wipe the entire team in a 1v1 match
[/list][*]Easy Pickings
[list][*]The new achievement objective is to destroy each Hive on the map at least once in a 3VAI or 3V3 Match
[/list][/list][*]Daily Bounties
[list][*]Any Daily Bounties that have a requirement of completing matches are not rewarded or counted towards in the following scenarios
[list][*]Dropping or resigning from the match before it was completed
[*]Being kicked from a match due to AFK detection
[/list][*]However, if a match ends due to the opponent player/team resigning before the match ends, those matches are counted as complete matches
[/list][*]Objectives
[list][*]Alpha Strike is now an objective on the Styx Map
[*]Changes have been made to ensure players will not receive Eradicate and Max Eradicate objectives in the same match[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Top Right UI Improvements
[list][*]Upcoming rewards are now displayed when hovering over the Player XP and Level
[*]The progress bar has been updated to be more noticeable / less subtle
[*]The Blueprints button has been removed – a Crafting button is now located in the Builder under the gear/software selection list
[*]Hovering over the Player Portrait now produces a quick navigation menu with all the menus located in the Player Profile (Change Portrait, Overview, Rewards Timeline, Masteries, Collections, Match History, and Account Settings)
[/list][*]Masteries Polish
[list][*]A Masteries option has been added to the Main Menu for easier navigation
[*]Crate Graphics within the Masteries Page have been improved
[*]Background art has been added for each Mastery
[*]Font sizes have been changed to improve readability – other improvements have been made to make completed masteries more noticeable 
[*]Mousing over stars will now show rewards, similar to how mousing over crates shows rewards
[/list][*]Rewards Sequence Polish
[list][*]Specific gear is now shown rather than a generic crates screen
[*]Now that the rewards are automatically surfaced, crate rewards will be placed in the Collections menu rather than the Crates menu
[*]Improved the timing and responsiveness of rewards screens (you can now click anywhere to advance animations faster)
[*]Improvements have been made to distinguish between blueprints and crates and gear
[*]The XP amounts are now shown with a bar in all of the UI
[/list][*]Shop Improvements
[list][*]The improved Crate Shop that was previously only accessed through the Builder and Crate Opening screens is now available in the Shop
[*]Pilot Details are now listed in the Shop
[/list][*]Minimap icons display option has been changed to display Pilot Portraits by default. This setting can be changed back to numbers in the Interface tab of the options menu
[*]Various improvements have been made to AI players – they now use additional abilities such as Twinned Coils, Flamethrowers Atomic Welder, Plasma Rifle, Assault Plasma etc.
[*]A medium difficulty all-Summoners team has been added to the AI team rotation
[*]The Resume button is now located under the Play button
[*]A “Masteries” button has been added to the Main Menu
[*]The match results screen now supports showing rewards that are immediately delivered and not opened via Crates. These rewards will animate up to the Collections panel
[*]The Rewards page now shows the amount of XP earned in addition to the XP radials – this number will count up as the radial is animating
[*]The XP bar and the experience that display in the player profile are now hidden when the user goes to a panel with sub-tabs, like the ranked panel or the masteries panel
[*]Added pagination mousewheel scrolling to the Rewards Timeline and the Match History page of the player profile
[*]Blueprint rewards will now animate to the profile gear collections panel[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where connecting Knockout’s Haymaker special to a flying Sniper over a chasm would teleport the Sniper to the center of the uplink cause a loss of control

notes.content:
Commanders, this week's patch will deploy on [b]Wednesday, June 14[/b].

[list][*]Queue Penalty Improvements
[list][*]Abandon and Surrender options have been added to the in-game options menu
[*]Getting kicked from a game due to AFK detection, disconnecting from a game, and choosing the abandon option in a match with 2+ human players is considered toxic behavior and will be subject to a queue penalty
[*]Gracefully resigning, Team Surrender, and choosing to resign in matches with one remaining human player on the team is considered acceptable behavior and will not be met with a penalty
[/list][*]Surrendering
[list][*]Surrender voting replaces Resign in matches with more than one human player on the same team. If a vote passes, all players on that team concede the match and the match ends. The player who calls the vote is automatically voted 'for' surrender. Players who call a vote cannot call another vote for 5 minutes
[*]After Minute Y (5+ min), a team can vote to surrender, both in ranked and unranked. Voting is counted among all connected humans players on the team, abstaining from the vote counts as 'don't surrender'. The vote must be unanimous to pass
[*]After Minute Z (10+ min) a surrender vote can be passed with a majority vote, instead of a unanimous vote
[*]Gracefully resigning treats AI teammates as a non-vote
[/list][*]Achievements
[list][*]To address the recent change where Achievements can no longer be earned in Custom Lobby or Challenge matches, the 2v2 specific achievements have been changed
[*]Double Humiliation
[list][*]This achievement is now called Humiliation
[*]The new achievement objective is to team Wipe the entire team in a 1v1 match
[/list][*]Easy Pickings
[list][*]The new achievement objective is to destroy each Hive on the map at least once in a 3VAI or 3V3 Match
[/list][/list][*]Daily Bounties
[list][*]Any Daily Bounties that have a requirement of completing matches are not rewarded or counted towards in the following scenarios
[list][*]Dropping or resigning from the match before it was completed
[*]Being kicked from a match due to AFK detection
[/list][*]However, if a match ends due to the opponent player/team resigning before the match ends, those matches are counted as complete matches

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2236
notes.content:
Commanders, this week's patch will deploy on [b]Thursday, June 8[/b].

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]3v3 Improvements
[list][*]The Command Grid in Team 3v3 now displays your teammates’ health and respawn timers, similar to the Command Grid in the 1v1 game mode
[list][*]Hovering over allied pilot icons in the Command Grid will display your teammates’ gear loadout and skill cooldowns
[/list][/list][*]AFK Detection
[list][*]AFK detection is active in any mode where there is more than 1 human player (1v1, 2v2, 3v3, Infestation)
[*]If a player has not made any commands in 90 seconds they will receive a timed pop up asking them if they are still playing. If the pop up is not responded to, the player will be removed from the match, they will receive a quickmatch penalty, and they will be replaced in the match with an AI player
[/list][*]Quickmatch Penalty
[list][*]Quickmatch penalties have been put in place to prevent negative behavior that impacts the enjoyment of other players
[*]Players can receive a Quickmatch penalty for:
[list][*]Resigning from Draft
[*]Being kicked from a game due to AFK detection 
[/list][*]Players who receive a Quickmatch penalty will be unable to re-enter the queue (search for games) until the penalty timer expires
[*]The Quickmatch penalty timer is shown under the Quickmatch button as well as in the Quickmatch Menu
[*]The Quickmatch penalty timers will increase if players continue to show degenerate behavior
[/list][*]Achievements
[list][*]Achievements can no longer be earned in Custom Lobby Matches or Challenge Matches
[*]Due to this change, ‘Easy Pickings’ and ‘Double Humiliation’ cannot be completed at this time. They will be revised in an upcoming patch
[/list][*]Core locations for the shared hive in Styx have been updated. The cores will now spawn in a symmetrical way that’s fair to both teams[/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Vanity (WIP)
[list][*]Alter-egos skins and effects are now on a per-gear basis, and can be equipped to any Pilot that can use that gear
[list][*]Players that purchased Squad or Commander Bundles will receive alter-ego skins for each gear piece that comprised an Alter-ego
[*]Equipping a full set of alter-ego gear on eligible pilots will automatically switch their 2D pilot art and special move effects to their alter-ego version (Currently Daredevil Recon, Steam-powered Pandora, and Sportsball Vise)
[*]The Alter-ego menu button in the builder is no longer available
[/list][/list][/list][i]Comments: With alter-egos, we wanted to create “What If?” alternate versions of pilots—what if Vise never took up core hunting, but became famous as a professional Sportsball player? While players thought that was cool, you also told us that the locked-in loadouts for alter-egos made them really limiting.
We’ve now tied the alter-ego skins and effects to gear pieces, so you can equip the skins on other pilots as well. (Example: using “Daredevil”-themed Rocket Cluster on Vanguard.)[/i]
[list][*]The detection stat is now shown on the Stats Bar of the Command Grid
[list][*]Because of this change, the kills stat is no longer shown on the Stats bar of the Command Grid – but this stat can still be observed on the Match Results screen
[/list][*]The detection stat is now shown on the tilde menu’s stats section’
[*]Initiating a search in the Quickmatch menu now plays SFX
[*]The XP bar has been updated to include a darker border, this is to prevent issues like the XP bar being obscured by the lava on the Styx map
[*]The Pilot Details page style has been updated and now includes Pilot detection stats
[*]Completed Daily Quests will now show different text based on their category
[*]Custom Lobby chat will no longer automatically open when a Custom Lobby is created[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where new players without the Squad or Commander bundles were not getting Sniper gear at certain level ups correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where the Tier I Mastery Chest could be opened again after the Mastery Tour was completed (These rewards were not given twice)
[*]Fixed an issue where toggling the ready up option during the final second of the custom lobby countdown sequence would result in an error 
[*]Fixed an issue where health bar names could overlap and result in player names showing up on other rigs health bars
[*]Fixed an issue where the Battle Cry effect would appear twice on the Command Grid if two were used near allied rigs at the same time. This effect did not actually stack, this was just a status effect fix for the Command Grid
[*]Fixed an issue where clicking the 3-Rig Mastery button on the Player Overview page resulted in the user being taken to the 1-Rig mastery page
[*]Fixed an issue where Omnipresence played no SFX when a user teleported in from off-screen
[*]Fixed an issue where the Custom Games main menu option was not properly localized in all non-English languages
[*]Fixed an issue where the boss stun ability VFX was cut off in certain areas 
[*]Fixed an issue where the banners for Wallace-Grumlin and Song Industries crates displayed truncated names
[*]Fixed an issue where Tutorial Introduction pop ups displayed past-tense text – this text now reads “Skills Covered” 
[*]Fixed an issue where the player portrait would not update in the party UI after it was changed
[*]Fixed an issue where Momentum Shifter could hit more than one large target
[list][*]If a smaller target is hit on the same frame as a large target, they will still get the knockback
[/list][*]Minor SFX fixes
[*]Minor localization fixes
[*]Fixed an issue where Bounties were being awarded when you would resign from a 3v3 match
[*]Fixed an issue where Lapse Generator and Nanite Wall were not counting towards the Mastery quest “The More the Merrier”[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

What are your thoughts on the changes in this update? Let us know in the forums!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2200
notes.content:
Commanders, we've got a massive update coming your way tomorrow, [b]Wednesday, May 31[/b]! 

We've lifted the cloaking field on our 5th class, and the first Sniper pilot, LYNX, will be available for EVERYONE to play tomorrow. And where better to play than on a brand new map, STYX.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/35eaa647108661d3a032886dab1cbcaa29f44501.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]New Map: Styx[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/f1404c390c3a3657e0024e19ac9cba58892d1bfa.png[/img]

[i]Once Drauger Limited's foremost testing ground for military innovation, this subterranean installation poised above a flow of magma was formerly known the Bergstrom Engineering Development Complex (BEDC), until a rampaging Kavash Boss drove everyone off and made the site its lair. [list][*]This tab includes collected gear, pilots, custom vision towers, blueprints, etc.

[*]The gear crate contents for Seasons 1-3 have been revised to include the new Sniper gear

[*]Pilot hover cards now have detection stats

[*]New ability damage FX has been added for Sidewinder Frame

[/list][*]Transmissions layout and text have been improved[/list]

[*]Fixed an issue where players could pick what rigs to take in 3-Rig Mastery’s mission Core Rush I
[list][*]This mission will now auto select Fury, Knockout and General Vex
[/list][*]Fixed an issue where there was a scoreboard for two players was showing in all variations of Core Rush
[*]Fixed an issue where 3-Rig Core Rush II was missing a text description in the Masteries page
[*]Fixed an issue where AI teammate uploads were not counting towards the score goals in 1 Rig Core Rush I
[*]Fixed an issue where 3-Rig Core Rush missions were on the wrong map. These missions should now occur on Juggernaut or Mind the Gap
[*]Fixed an issue where the level up rewards preview could overlap with the Transmissions list
[*]Fixed an issue where the Rewards screen would play the XP progression SFX even when the player had not gained any XP
[*]Fixed an issue where buying a 6th pilot would not update the 1v1 Ranking area to appear unlocked in the Player Overview without a client restart
[*]Fixed an issue where custom resolutions could break the Crafting Menu
[*]Fixed an issue where enabling the Password option within a Custom Lobby did not stop the 10 second countdown before transitioning into Draft
[*]Fixed an issue where the “Not Enough Jovians” alert that surfaced during an attempted purchase was incorrect
[*]Fixed an issue where teammate cooldowns were not shown in the tilde menu during 3v3 matches
[*]Fixed an issue where initiating a quickmatch search while a Pilot Details page was open resulted in the animated pilot portrait no longer displaying
[*]Fixed an issue where replay codes could be obscured by the Watch button on lower resolution options
[*]Fixed an issue where a hidden achievement was not being awarded correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where minimizing and reopening the Quickmatch menu repeatedly after starting a search resulted in the timer appearing to pause
[*]Fixed an issue where Kavash kills were not being earned correctly on the Crush Some Bugs Mastery Quest
[*]Fixed an issue where replaying tutorial missions would still display ‘Skip Tutorial’ on the options menu – replaying tutorial missions now properly show the ‘Resign’ option
[*]Fixed an issue where rigs dying over a chasm would cause an incorrect animation to player rather than the full correct animation
[*]Fixed an issue where hosts could not kick players from parties after resigning a match
[*]Fixed some overlapping text issues
[*]Various SFX fixes
[*]Various localization fixes
[/list][h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

We're really looking forward to hearing what you think of Lynx, Styx, and all the other changes in this update! Let us know your thoughts, Commanders, and see you on Europa!

[*]Fixed an issue where enabling the Password option within a Custom Lobby did not stop the 10 second countdown before transitioning into Draft
[*]Fixed an issue where the “Not Enough Jovians” alert that surfaced during an attempted purchase was incorrect
[*]Fixed an issue where teammate cooldowns were not shown in the tilde menu during 3v3 matches
[*]Fixed an issue where initiating a quickmatch search while a Pilot Details page was open resulted in the animated pilot portrait no longer displaying
[*]Fixed an issue where replay codes could be obscured by the Watch button on lower resolution options
[*]Fixed an issue where a hidden achievement was not being awarded correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where minimizing and reopening the Quickmatch menu repeatedly after starting a search resulted in the timer appearing to pause
[*]Fixed an issue where Kavash kills were not being earned correctly on the Crush Some Bugs Mastery Quest

[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

We're really looking forward to hearing what you think of Lynx, Styx, and all the other changes in this update! Let us know your thoughts, Commanders, and see you on Europa!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2166
notes.content:
We've heard your requests, Commanders! In this week's patch, deploying Wednesday, May 24, we're adding Ranked 3v3 mode! Note that this mode (as with Ranked 1v1) is still WIP, and we'll continue to update 3v3 and Ranked 3v3 modes based on your feedback.

In this patch we're also adding new ways to get rewards, and revamped UI to better show your progression! 

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Ranked 3v3 mode has been added
[list][*]Ranked 3v3 mode unlocks at Account Level 5
[*]Each player takes turns selecting their pilot
[list][*]Pilot picks are exclusive PER TEAM (Example: Both teams may have one Knockout, but a team cannot have two Knockouts)[/list]
[*]There is no sideboard for Ranked 3v3
[*]Players can use loadouts from any of their saved squads
[/list][*]Mastery Boards
[list][*]Complete Quests and Scenarios for rewards with new Mastery Boards
[*]1-rig and 3-rig control Mastery Boards are available
[*]Increase your Mastery rank to unlock new customizations[/list]
[*]Daily Bounties
[list][*]Additional Daily Bounties have been added to the rotation, including:
[list][*]Complete 3 games with a Tank-class rig
[*]Complete 3 games with a Gunner-class rig
[*]Complete 3 games with a Mechanic-class rig
[*]Complete 3 games with a Summoner-class rig
[*]Complete 5 games with a Tank-class or Gunner-class rig
[*]Complete 5 games with a Mechanic-class or Summoner-class rig
[/list][*]Two Daily Bounties have been discontinued from the rotation:
[list][*]Win 1 match
[*]Complete 3 matches
[/list][/list][*]New Feature Tours
[list][*]A Feature Tour has been added for the Quickmatch Menu
[*]A Feature Tour has been added for the Mastery Board[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Upper Right Profile Display
[list][*]The upper right display has been reworked to clearly show level progression, crates and crafting
[*]Jovian and Feds buttons now have tooltips to explain how to obtain Jovians and Feds
[*]The Crates and Crafting buttons have been improved to explicitly state their functionality
[*]The Player Name and Level area now shows the current level, progress bar and next level that will be obtained
[*]Clicking the Player Name in the upper right display will now take the Player to their Profile page
[*]Upper right display now shows gear unlocks for next level. Gear cards for this upcoming gear will show when hovered over[/list]
[*]Progress Pop Ups and animations have been added for the following events to mark significant progress and status updates to the appropriate areas
[list][*]Player Level Ups
[*]Pilot Level Ups
[*]Mode Unlocks (3VAI, 3V3, Ranked 1V1 and 3V3 etc.)
[*]Unlock Mastery Type
[*]Bounty Completion
[*]Contract Completion
[*]Mastery Node Completion
[*]Ranked Division Promotion
[/list][*]Feature Gate
[list][*]Random Daily Bounties will now be received until the player has completed the initial set of bounties
[/list][*]Progress Animation
[list][*]From the Rewards screen, XP and Jovian rewards animate to the upper right with animated increments
[/list][*]Play Flow Panels have been improved to support the new Mastery Boards
[*]Tutorial transmissions have been simplified to more directly state what players must do to complete the tutorials and what they will receive when they do
[*]Ground Pounder FX has been updated
[*]Post-Match Chat now starts in the half-size, open state in the results screen
[*]Two new musical tracks have been added[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an exploit where players could use persistent AoE abilities to prevent the Kavash boss from auto-attacking
[*]Fixed an issue where the minimap would stop right-click accepting input
[*]Fixed an issue where Summoners would slide for a short period after teleporting with Hive Link
[*]Fixed an issue where the quickmatch UI would disappear if the player continuously entered and left Solo Modes
[*]Fixed an issue where kills earned by summoned turrets and goons did not count towards the Rig’s kill count
[*]Fixed an issue where Post-Match chat appeared in Solo Modes
[*]Fixed an issue where attempting to join a Custom Lobby while matchseeking did not warn the player that they would be removed from matchseeking
[*]Fixed an issue where the match objectives were not shown during the Match Basics tutorial’s draft sequence
[*]Minor localization fixes
[*]Minor SFX fixes
[*]Fixed an exploit where players could use persistant AoE abilities to prevent the Kavash boss from auto-attacking.[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between[/list]

We're eager to hear what you think of Ranked 3v3, Mastery Boards, and all of the other changes in update 2166! Let us know what you think on the forums!
