notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2103
notes.content:
Here are this week's patch notes, Commanders!

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]

[b][u]Gameplay Modes[/u][/b] 
[list][*]Account level requirements to unlock gameplay modes have changed
[list][*]Team 3v3 vs humans is now available immediately for players
[*]1v1 Ranked is now available at level 10 instead of level 15
[*]Solo Skirmish -> VS AI (Player VS Player) is now available immediately[/list]
[*]An Experience Selection screen has been added to the game that allows players to choose their level of experience with RTS and MOBA games
[list][*]“Beginner” will lead the player through the 3-mission tutorial experience, which should last <15 minutes
[*]“Experienced” will lead the player through a lighter, 2-mission tutorial experience, which should last <10 minutes[/list]
[*]Feature Tours have been added to certain sections of the game (WIP)
[list][*]Feature Tours are quick, text-based guides to walk you through new features, giving you all the important information you need to know
[list][*]The Builder Tour starts the first time a player clicks the BUILD menu[/list][/list]
[*]Kavash Aggro Changes
[list][*]Once a Hive has a target, it should consider all potential targets within its leash range. This fixes behavior where a Hive would continue targeting the same unit even though there was a unit closer
[*]Boss should wake up immediately when attacked, instead of a delay. Added a 2000ms delay between when the boss battle ends due to leashing and when the healing starts[/list]
[*]Vision Rules
[list][*]Auto-attacks and unit targeted abilities will grant vision of the attacking unit if the defender cannot see them (I.E. the attacker is in the fog of war)
[*]This vision is centered on the attacker's position at the time of release
[*]It lasts for 2s and has an 8.5m radius.[/list][/list]
[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Core Sight (Sensor Software)
[list][*]Now grants the Rig's team vision for 10s in a 50m radius around the uplink whenever the owning Rig uploads a Core[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Progression Screen (WIP)
[list][*]The Player Profile has been updated to give players a clearer sense of progression
[*]Upcoming rewards will be shown, as well as the goal that needs to be achieved to earn them (I.E. Next profile level, next match victory, next Pilot Level, etc.)
[*]Nearest Pilots to leveling will be shown (I.E. The 3 pilots closest to earning their next level, and the amount of experience needed for them to reach the next level)
[*]Player Leveling will be shown as well as the experience needed to attain the next Profile Level
[*]Ranking status (1v1, 3v3, etc.)  
[*]Clicking certain item in this page should take you to the appropriate screen for more information
[list][*]Clicking your player emblem will take you to the Player Emblem page
[*]Clicking Pilots should open their Details Page
[*]Clicking the 1v1 Ranked area should open either a Provisional Games view or your Ranked status, etc.[/list][/list]
[*]Match Results
[list][*]The Match Results screen has received updates to provide clearer information about the match as well as earned rewards
[*]The Match Results screen shown on Tutorial completion should now show the earned rewards and unlocks
[*]The Match Results screen now features more information to celebrate the match and how players fared
[list][*]In 1-Rig Team vs Team games, each player will receive a Title based on their performance
[*]In 3-Rig Player vs Player games, each pilot will receive a Title based on their performance
[*]In 3 or 4 player Infestation matches and 3-Rig 2v2 games, only the player’s best pilot will be shown, receiving a Title based on their performance[/list]
[*]The Match Results screen still features detailed stats tabs in addition to these new changes
[*]Rewards earned from matches are still shown after returning to the Main Menu[/list]
[*]Post-Match Chat
[list][*]There is now a Post-Match chat available in the Match Results screen
[*]This is an ALL chat and is available in 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3[/list]
[*]The Boss now has heal FX
[*]The low health VO for Summoners is now triggered when they reach 40% remaining health[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[*]Fixed an issue where players could override camera pan portions of the tutorial missions by using the camera center command
[*]Fixed an issue where Objective hover tooltips could be shown in Drafting sequences before the Objectives were in place
[*]Fixed an issue where Plasma Rifle’s FX did not match the animation played when activated in the Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where entering and leaving Test Squad would result in the Quickmatch UI disappearing
[*]Fixed an issue where the utility slot hit box would slightly overlap with the Special Move hit box when it was selected 
[*]Fixed an issue where a Gunner that used stealth plating within an enemy’s detection range would not be properly shown as detected 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Level Requirement text for 1v1 Unranked cited the wrong level
[*]Fixed an issue where an AI match could not be resumed if it was paused and received a match confirmation check that was missed 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Guided Bot Match (Match Basic tutorial) timer would begin counting down before the player had progressed through all of the beginning pop up messages
[*]Fixed an issue where kills earned by a Summoner Pilot’s summoned units would not count towards the Rig’s final kill count
[*]Fixed an issue where Recon did not have spawn FX when switched to in the Builder or in the Draft of a match
[*]Fixed an issue where the matchseeking bar was not updated and removed if the queue was cancelled by a party member 
[*]Fixed an issue where the matchseeking bar was not displaying in Solo AI matches and Pilot Training missions
[*]Fixed an issue where casting abilities with quickcast settings on top of the ping tooltip would cause issues
[*]Fixed an issue where Multiqueue checkboxes could be toggled while searching when an opposing player timed out on the match confirmation check
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3v3 Match Type was displaying string text in the Watch Menu
[*]Fixed an issue where the Kavash auto-attack animation did not transition back to idle immediately after completing
[*]Fixed an issue where health bars in older replays would display incorrect health levels when the units took damage 
[*]Fixed an issue where pings were appearing at the center of the map when loading into Test Squad
[*]Fixed an issue where Academy video audio would continue to play if Esc was pressed to return to the previous menu
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3v3 Match Results graph would split into separate lines when objectives were earned
[*]Fixed an issue where entering queue through the Play Menu did not uncheck queue options that were picked the last time you were queued
[*]Minor localization fixes and updates
[*]Minor SFX fixes and updates[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

We look forward to your feedback!

[*]Fixed an issue where Multiqueue checkboxes could be toggled while searching when an opposing player timed out on the match confirmation check
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3v3 Match Type was displaying string text in the Watch Menu
[*]Fixed an issue where the Kavash auto-attack animation did not transition back to idle immediately after completing
[*]Fixed an issue where health bars in older replays would display incorrect health levels when the units took damage 
[*]Fixed an issue where pings were appearing at the center of the map when loading into Test Squad
[*]Fixed an issue where Academy video audio would continue to play if Esc was pressed to return to the previous menu
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3v3 Match Results graph would split into separate lines when objectives were earned
[*]Fixed an issue where entering queue through the Play Menu did not uncheck queue options that were picked the last time you were queued
[*]Minor localization fixes and updates
[*]Minor SFX fixes and updates[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

We look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2055
notes.content:
This week's patch notes are here, Commanders! Version 2055 is incoming [b]Wednesday, May 10[/b].

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]A quicker tutorial experience has been added for new players
[list][*]Three quick missions starring Recon, focusing on 1-rig control[/list]
[*]Pings
[list][*]The ping radial (default key: [b]V[/b]) has been redesigned, and now allows players to quickly swipe their mouse in the direction of the ping they want to issue
[*]Positive and negative pings can still be issued using Alt-click and Ctrl-Alt-click, respectively[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/98755b35b4eae0fcd7d1caa49e2747944fa4d928.png[/img]

[*]Various AI improvements have been implemented (WIP)
[list][*]The player can issue positive pings to guide AI towards certain areas of the map
[*]The AI currently only responds to [b][i]positive[/i][/b] pings
[*]The AI will respond to player pings directly on Vision Towers, the Uplink, Hives, Kavash, Rigs, and the Dropship[/list][/list]
[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Plasma Rifle (Gunner Weapon)
[list][*]Amplified Ammo Speed increased from 55 to 75m/s for consistency with the base Plasma Rifle ammo[/list]
[*]Assault Plasma (Gunner Weapon)
[list][*]Increased base ammo speed to 65 for consistency with the amplified Assault Plasma ammo[/list]
[*]Rocket Cluster (Gunner Weapon) [Base and Daredevil Recon versions]
[list][*]Ammo time to impact reduced from 1.5 to 1.35s[/list]
[*]Atomic Welder (Mechanic Weapon)
[list][*]Ammo speed increased from 33 to 40 m/s[/list]
[*]Lapse Generator (Summoner Weapon)
[list][*]Attack Range increased from 17.5 to 20m
[*]Minion Attack Range decreased from 17 to 14m
[*]Minions will now spread out around the summoner while idle or moving. Clumping is still possible but should occur less often
[*]Minions will now move to engage nearby targets[/list]
[*]Capacity Overload (Mechanic Body)
[list][*]Ammo speed increased from 25 to 27.5 m/s[/list]
[*]Surge Amplifier (Mechanic Body)
[list][*]Ammo speed increased from 25 to 27.5 m/s[/list]
[*]Napalm Canisters (Mechanic Utility)
[list][*]Ammo time to impact reduced from .5 to .45s[/list]
[*]Skylance (Summoner Utility) [Base and Steam-Powered Pandora versions]
[list][*]Ammo time to impact reduced 2.5 to 2.3s[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Play Menu flow has been updated
[list][*]The new, shorter tutorial is now located in the ‘Learn’ Menu
[*]Pilot Training Missions are now located in the ‘Play’ Menu[/list]
[*]Quickmatch Window
[list][*]The Quickmatch Window has been updated
[*]Queues have been separated into ‘Team Up’ modes (Team 3v3) and ‘Duel’ modes (1v1)
[*]There is now a mouseover window for each queue option that describes the mode and any unlock requirements for the mode
[*]There is now a checkbox option to auto-minimize the Quickmatch Window once the player has started searching[/list]
[*]Gear crates in the shop are now based off Corporations instead of seasons. The gear available in these crates will be specific to that Corporation. (Such as Wallace Grumlin, Song, etc.) Due to this, various gear pieces will also have a change in manufacturer

[i]Comments: Labeling gear crates based on the corporation that manufactured them makes it easier for players to understand what types of gear they can expect to receive in those crates. It also gives us some creative freedom to explore and flesh out the corporations that hold power throughout the solar system.[/i]

[*]Some transmissions have received text and icon updates
[*]Hive Link’s destination FX has been updated[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Hive idle animations would freeze after aggroing the hive and then walking away
[*]Fixed an issue where the dormant Hive idle animation would pause a bit before looping 
[*]Fixed an issue with the timing of one of the Boss abilities so the animations and FX no longer cut off early
[*]Fixed an issue where custom lobby options’ hover text would not appear correctly due to inconsistent hitbox areas – this issue is fixed now but there is a 500ms delay before help text appears
[*]Fixed an issue where killing the Boss while it was performing its stun attack resulted in the animation persisting beyond the Boss’ death
[*]Fixed an issue where the Blueprints menu was misaligned
[*]Fixed an issue where transmissions borders were appearing incorrectly
[*]Fixed some text alignment issues with transmissions
[*]Fixed an issue where rigs would rubber-band onto elevators within the tutorial missions
[*]Fixed an issue where Ranked matches displayed ‘Unranked’ in the Watch Menu
[*]Fixed an issue where Graphene Matrix’s shield FX would stay in place briefly after blocking an attack
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented players from searching for 1v1 modes after a party invitee left the  party
[*]Minor localization fixes
[*]Minor SFX fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

Let us know what you think about these changes in the forums, Commanders! 

€dit:
This week's release will include EN, DE, RU, PT and BR. The other languages will be delivered in next week's release. Please excuse the inconvenience.

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2023
notes.content:
Commanders, it's time for patch notes! Version 2023 will deploy [b]Wednesday, May 3[/b]:

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Kavash Boss
[list][*]Bosses will no longer aggro units via proximity. The boss will now become aggro'd only after being attacked by a unit 
[*]The boss no longer has minions 
[*]Boss auto attack range reduced from 25m to 21m
[*]Boss auto attack DPS increased from 110 to 150
[*]Each time the boss respawns, it gains a stacking Max Health + Damage boost: +100 HP and +20 weapon DPS for each time the boss has respawned
[list][*]This boost does not apply the first time the boss is spawned in the match[/list]
[*]Bosses now have two abilities they can cast
[list][*]Quick Ability - Deals 100 damage and slows enemies in a wide frontal cone, up to 25m away. Slow debuff lasts for 1.5s and lowers speed by 10%
[*]Ultimate Ability - While charging up, the boss will continuously release chain lightning at the closest enemy. Chain lightning:
[list][*]Deals 75 damage
[*]Chains to up to 3 targets in a 15m range
[*]20% damage fall off between targets[/list]
The boss will reach full charge after 3.6 seconds. Once fully charged, the boss will discharge lightning in a 25m AoE around itself, dealing 200 damage to each target struck and stunning them for 1.5s[/list]
[*]Boss powerups will now disappear if they have not been collected before the new boss spawns, which is every 2 minutes. The 90s buff status you receive once you have clicked on the powerup remains unchanged[/list][/list]

[i]Comments: We wanted to make the act of bossing more gradual over time, with a clear ramp up in the boss's strength (much like the hives) to better scale with player unit progression during a match. We also wanted to make the boss a more interactive fight and less about just having your tankiest rig stand in front of it and soak up damage, while your DPS whittled down its health. Now, players will need to be mindful of their unit positioning and rotation when the boss is activating its abilities.[/i]

[list][*]Queuing up orders after issuing a back-to-base order will now wait for the rig to fully heal before resuming the remaining queued orders[/list]
[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Positron Condenser (Mechanic Weapon)
[list][*]AA release point moved from 350ms to 250ms
[*]AA resume time lowered from 600ms to 500ms
[*]Ability release point changed from 280ms to 200ms
[*]Ability cast point moved from 0 to 100ms
[*]Ability resume point lowered from 350ms to 300ms[/list][/list]
[list][*]Graphene Matrix (Mechanic Body)
[list][*]Now an object-targeted ability
[*]Attack negation buff duration reduced from 2s to 1s
[*]Speed buff duration unchanged at 2s
[*]Cooldown has been changed to 8s[/list][/list]
[b][u]Pilot Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Recon
[list][*]Recon’s default body slot gear has been changed from Stealth Plating to Thrusters[/list]
[*]Vise
[list][*]Vise’s default utility gear slot has been changed from Frequency Adaptation to Momentum Shifter[/list]
[*]Widget
[list][*]Widget’s default body gear slot has been changed from Nanite Amplifiers to Graphene Matrix[/list][/list]

[i]Comments: We heard your feedback! Many new players felt that some pieces of default gear for Recon, Vise, and Widget just didn't feel as fun as some other options. (For example, Frequency Adaptation and Nanite Amplifiers are both passive abilities.) While we still feel that those pieces of gear have their uses in builds, we agree that new players should get some cool, more interactive gear when first starting out.[/i]

[list][*]Cortex’s Special Move: Drone Strikes
[list][*]Drone Strikes is now a channel ability
[*]Players can move-cancel their channel after the first drone strike wave (1000ms)
[*]Interrupting this channel will cease further drone strikes[/list][/list]

[i]Comments: Drone Strikes is a great ability for denial of a large area, which was made all the more powerful by Cortex being able to drop it and still move around and cast other abilities! Drone Strikes now requires Cortex to be completely focused while calling in his drones, which requires players to be a bit more judicious about how and when they use it.[/i]

[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Ranked Divisions have been updated
[list][*]A ‘Ranked’ page has been added to the Player Profile section. This page shows the player’s current Division, as well as their current Reputation Points (Rep) and the Rep they will need to get to the next Division. (You must be level 15 or higher to access this page)
[*]10 Provisional games must be completed to determine what Division you belong in
[*]Once you are in a Division, each game you win or lose will adjust your rep points closer to a higher or lower Division
[*]When you reach the maximum points of your Division you will be placed in ‘Promotional Mode’. In this mode you must win 3 games to confirm your transition into a higher Division
[*]If you reach zero points of your Division you will be placed in ‘Critical Mode’. In this mode you will have three chances to win a match to keep you in your current Division. If you lose all three matches you will be demoted to a lower Division
[*]Rep and Division information is also now displayed in the Post Match Results screen
[*]Only Bronze and Silver are available at the moment. Remaining Divisions to come in the future.[/list]
[*]Changes to the Play Menu flow are underway and are still WIP
[*]A ‘Learn’ option has been added to the Main Menu that features Academy videos, geared towards teaching players tips and tricks while playing Dropzone. (WIP)
[*]A ‘Custom Games’ option has been added to the Main Menu, players can now navigate here to create custom lobbies
[*]In 3v3 Matches, clicking the upgrade button will now automatically upgrade the player’s owned pilot, rather than making them choose their pilot to upgrade
[*]Difficulty buttons have been added to Solo VS AI play flow panels. These buttons have hover text explaining the difficulty and reward percentages earned based off the chosen difficulty
[*]Armor stats have been added to the Pilot Stats panel shown in the Builder
[*]‘Enable Latency Adjustment’ option has been added to improve performance for slower connections[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where pilot default gear and the same non-default gear would play different FX in the Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where the incorrect rig would show on the dropship in Draft if the pilot choice was changed before being locked in during the ‘pilot picking’ phase
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur for players with many available scenarios / missions on their account
[*]Fixed an issue where players could resign from Test Loadout. Players must now click ‘Return to Builder’ to leave Test Loadout
[*]Fixed a sim server crash that could occur if multiple Nanite Walls were placed in the same location
[*]Fixed an issue with Thrusters that prevented chain-casting all three charges, depending upon input timing. Thrusters should feel more responsive when multi-casting now
[*]Fixed an issue where Crazed Banshee’s targeting decal would remain on the intended target if the ammo was redirected with Black Hole Shell
[*]Minor SFX fixes
[*]Minor localization fixes and updates[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run.

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v2023
notes.content:
Commanders, it's time for patch notes! Version 2023 will deploy [b]Wednesday, May 3[/b]:

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Kavash Boss
[list][*]Bosses will no longer aggro units via proximity. The boss will now become aggro'd only after being attacked by a unit 
[*]The boss no longer has minions 
[*]Boss auto attack range reduced from 25m to 21m
[*]Boss auto attack DPS increased from 110 to 150
[*]Each time the boss respawns, it gains a stacking Max Health + Damage boost: +100 HP and +20 weapon DPS for each time the boss has respawned
[list][*]This boost does not apply the first time the boss is spawned in the match[/list]
[*]Bosses now have two abilities they can cast
[list][*]Quick Ability - Deals 100 damage and slows enemies in a wide frontal cone, up to 25m away. Slow debuff lasts for 1.5s and lowers speed by 10%
[*]Ultimate Ability - While charging up, the boss will continuously release chain lightning at the closest enemy. Chain lightning:
[list][*]Deals 75 damage
[*]Chains to up to 3 targets in a 15m range
[*]20% damage fall off between targets[/list]
The boss will reach full charge after 3.6 seconds. Once fully charged, the boss will discharge lightning in a 25m AoE around itself, dealing 200 damage to each target struck and stunning them for 1.5s[/list]
[*]Boss powerups will now disappear if they have not been collected before the new boss spawns, which is every 2 minutes. The 90s buff status you receive once you have clicked on the powerup remains unchanged[/list][/list]

[i]Comments: We wanted to make the act of bossing more gradual over time, with a clear ramp up in the boss's strength (much like the hives) to better scale with player unit progression during a match. We also wanted to make the boss a more interactive fight and less about just having your tankiest rig stand in front of it and soak up damage, while your DPS whittled down its health. Now, players will need to be mindful of their unit positioning and rotation when the boss is activating its abilities.[/i]

[list][*]Queuing up orders after issuing a back-to-base order will now wait for the rig to fully heal before resuming the remaining queued orders[/list]
[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Positron Condenser (Mechanic Weapon)
[list][*]AA release point moved from 350ms to 250ms
[*]AA resume time lowered from 600ms to 500ms
[*]Ability release point changed from 280ms to 200ms
[*]Ability cast point moved from 0 to 100ms
[*]Ability resume point lowered from 350ms to 300ms[/list][/list]
[list][*]Graphene Matrix (Mechanic Body)
[list][*]Now an object-targeted ability
[*]Attack negation buff duration reduced from 2s to 1s
[*]Speed buff duration unchanged at 2s
[*]Cooldown has been changed to 8s[/list][/list]
[b][u]Pilot Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Recon
[list][*]Recon’s default body slot gear has been changed from Stealth Plating to Thrusters[/list]
[*]Vise
[list][*]Vise’s default utility gear slot has been changed from Frequency Adaptation to Momentum Shifter[/list]
[*]Widget
[list][*]Widget’s default body gear slot has been changed from Nanite Amplifiers to Graphene Matrix[/list][/list]

[i]Comments: We heard your feedback! Many new players felt that some pieces of default gear for Recon, Vise, and Widget just didn't feel as fun as some other options. (For example, Frequency Adaptation and Nanite Amplifiers are both passive abilities.) While we still feel that those pieces of gear have their uses in builds, we agree that new players should get some cool, more interactive gear when first starting out.[/i]

[list][*]Cortex’s Special Move: Drone Strikes
[list][*]Drone Strikes is now a channel ability
[*]Players can move-cancel their channel after the first drone strike wave (1000ms)
[*]Interrupting this channel will cease further drone strikes[/list][/list]

[i]Comments: Drone Strikes is a great ability for denial of a large area, which was made all the more powerful by Cortex being able to drop it and still move around and cast other abilities! Drone Strikes now requires Cortex to be completely focused while calling in his drones, which requires players to be a bit more judicious about how and when they use it.[/i]

[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Ranked Divisions have been updated
[list][*]A ‘Ranked’ page has been added to the Player Profile section. This page shows the player’s current Division, as well as their current Reputation Points (Rep) and the Rep they will need to get to the next Division. (You must be level 15 or higher to access this page)
[*]10 Provisional games must be completed to determine what Division you belong in
[*]Once you are in a Division, each game you win or lose will adjust your rep points closer to a higher or lower Division
[*]When you reach the maximum points of your Division you will be placed in ‘Promotional Mode’. In this mode you must win 3 games to confirm your transition into a higher Division
[*]If you reach zero points of your Division you will be placed in ‘Critical Mode’. In this mode you will have three chances to win a match to keep you in your current Division. If you lose all three matches you will be demoted to a lower Division
[*]Rep and Division information is also now displayed in the Post Match Results screen
[*]Only Bronze and Silver are available at the moment. Remaining Divisions to come in the future.[/list]
[*]Changes to the Play Menu flow are underway and are still WIP
[*]A ‘Learn’ option has been added to the Main Menu that features Academy videos, geared towards teaching players tips and tricks while playing Dropzone. (WIP)
[*]A ‘Custom Games’ option has been added to the Main Menu, players can now navigate here to create custom lobbies
[*]In 3v3 Matches, clicking the upgrade button will now automatically upgrade the player’s owned pilot, rather than making them choose their pilot to upgrade
[*]Difficulty buttons have been added to Solo VS AI play flow panels. These buttons have hover text explaining the difficulty and reward percentages earned based off the chosen difficulty
[*]Armor stats have been added to the Pilot Stats panel shown in the Builder
[*]‘Enable Latency Adjustment’ option has been added to improve performance for slower connections[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where pilot default gear and the same non-default gear would play different FX in the Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where the incorrect rig would show on the dropship in Draft if the pilot choice was changed before being locked in during the ‘pilot picking’ phase
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur for players with many available scenarios / missions on their account
[*]Fixed an issue where players could resign from Test Loadout. Players must now click ‘Return to Builder’ to leave Test Loadout
[*]Fixed a sim server crash that could occur if multiple Nanite Walls were placed in the same location
[*]Fixed an issue with Thrusters that prevented chain-casting all three charges, depending upon input timing. Thrusters should feel more responsive when multi-casting now
[*]Fixed an issue where Crazed Banshee’s targeting decal would remain on the intended target if the ammo was redirected with Black Hole Shell
[*]Minor SFX fixes
[*]Minor localization fixes and updates[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[*]AVG antivirus software may incorrectly flag the Dropzone client as malicious. We have reached out to them to whitelist the client. In the meantime, you should be able to manually allow your antivirus software to allow the Dropzone client to run. 
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

As always Commanders, we look forward to hearing your feedback on these changes! Let us know your thoughts in the forums!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v1989
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders! There will be a new game update [b]tomorrow, Wednesday, April 26[/b], with changes to gameplay, gear, and pilots; as well as quality-of-life suggestions from you, our player community; and lots of bug fixes!

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Pushes and pulls no longer interrupt abilities
[list][*]Example: Abilities like Palm Rockets and Dyno Vortex will no longer stop Recon's Orbital Strike channel. The same goes for pushes and pulls affecting abilities like Pulverizers, Rocket Cluster, etc.[/list][/list]
[i][b]Dev comments:[/b] Previously, push/pull abilities would interrupt enemy rigs' abilities, effectively acting as a silence. Removing the interrupt still gives players the advantage of re-positioning opposing units. This also opens up more possibilities for future gear, as push/pull abilities would have needed to be balanced with longer cooldowns if they always acted as a silence.[/i]
[list][*]Detection on Damaged
[list][*]Duration reduced from 2s to 1s[/list]
[*]Input, Orders, and Responsiveness
[list][*]Fixed an issue where abilities would queue until stun completion and were unable to be cleared.  Issuing orders to stunned units will overwrite existing orders on that unit.
[*]It is now possible to interrupt Litany of Plagues with a new ability order, such as Reconstructive Maneuver. Issuing active-ability orders to units casting an ability will queue the new order for as soon as the current spell is interruptible instead of the full spell cast.[/list]
[*]Click priority for Kavash workers has been increased slightly
[*]Boss Pit healing buff now provides 20 armor instead of having to compensate with healing rate[/list]
[i][b]Dev comments:[/b] Players were able to overcome the regeneration of the boss minions by attacking them outside of aggro range. Providing additional armor lessens the effectiveness of attacks from outside the boss pit, when the boss isn't aggro'd. Keeping the regeneration static makes sure the boss doesn't heal too quickly when players briefly leave the aggro range.[/i]
[list][*]Hive spawn and leash locations should now be symmetrical in regards to the uplink
[*]Steam Achievement Changes:
[list][*]Some changes were made to prevent certain achievements from being unlocked in certain modes
[*]The following Achievements cannot be earned in Challenge Matches or Custom Lobby Matches 
[*]‘Double Humiliation’ - Team Wipe the entire enemy team in a 2v2 match
[list][*]Can only be earned in a 2v2 VS Humans match[/list]
[*]‘Don’t Move’ - Root an enemy Rig, and then destroy it while it’s rooted
[list][*]Can be earned in any mode, Humans or AI[/list]
[*]‘Death From Above’ - Destroy an enemy Rig with the Tank ability ‘Landfall’
[list][*]Can be earned in any mode, Humans or AI[/list]
[*]‘Home Sweet Horror’ - Destroy an enemy Rig while it's healing in its dropship
[list][*]Can now be earned in any mode, Humans or AI
[*]The achievement text has been updated to no longer include ‘(PvP)’[/list]
[*]‘Easy Pickings’ - Destroy each Hive on the map at least once in a 2v2 match
[list][*]Can be earned in either 2v2 Mode, Humans or AI[/list]
[*]‘All Cores Belong to Me’ - Upload 36 cores in a single match
[list][*]Can now be earned in any mode, Humans or AI
[*]The achievement text has been updated to no longer include ‘(PvP)’[/list]
[*]‘Interruption’ - Cancel an enemy Rig's channeled ability with a silence
[list][*]This Steam Achievement has been updated and is no longer limited to abilities that silence
[*]The achievement text has been updated to reflect this change, the new text is ‘Interrupt an enemy channel’
[*]Can be earned in any mode, Humans or AI[/list]
[*]All other Steam achievements not including the ones above can be earned in any mode, Challenge Matches and Custom Lobbies included[/list][/list]
[h1]Gear Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Gravity Gun [i](Summoner Weapon)[/i]
[list][*]Damage increased from 110 to 160
[*]Cast range reduced from 35m to 30m
[*]Cooldown reduced from 36s to 28s[/list]
[*]Laser Lens [i](Summoner Weapon)[/i]
[list][*]Damage changed from --/--/400/450/500 to --/--/400/475/575[/list]
[*]Crazed Banshee [i](Summoner Weapon)[/i]
[list][*]Cooldown reduced from 25s to 18s at all levels
[*]The missile now accelerates for 4 seconds, starting at 250ms after it’s been fired
[*]The missile’s raw speed increases from 10m/s to 25m/s over 4 seconds
[*]The missile deals between 0-50% bonus damage depending on how fast it’s going at the time of impact. Maximum bonus damage will be dealt after the missile hits max speed (4.25s)[/list]
[*]Nanite Ray [i](Mechanic Weapon)[/i]
[list][*]Now does additional damage / healing equal to 5% of the target’s max HP[/list]
[*]Quantum Mire [i](Summoner Body)[/i]
[list][*]Damage dealt now ignores armor[/list]
[*]Stealth Plating [i](Gunner Body)[/i]
[list][*]Cooldown reduced from 24s to 20s
[*]Duration changed from 6s to --/6/8/10/12s[/list]
[*]Thrusters [i](Gunner Body)[/i]
[list][*]Now has 3 charges
[*]Travel distance reduced from 26m to 11m
[*]Travel time reduced from 400ms to 300ms
[*]Cooldown reduced from 30s to 15s[/list][/list]
[i][b]Dev comments:[/b] We wanted to give Thrusters a more "active" feel, which also helps to differentiate Thrusters from Boosters. (We'll probably take a look at sprucing up Boosters later on.)[/i]
[list][*]Mass Field [i](Mechanic Utility)[/i]
[list][*]Slow debuff duration reduced from 3s to 1s. The overall field still lasts the full 5.5s[/list]
[*]Cleansing Cells [i](Mechanic Body)[/i]
[list][*]Debuff immunity reduced from 4.5s to 2s[/list]
[*]Martyr’s Boon [i](Mechanic Utility)[/i]
[list][*]Health cost reduced from 300HP to 225HP[/list]
[*]Core Shelter [i](Defensive Software)[/i]
[list][*]Now grants the owner a stronger bonus than their allies
[*]The owner gets +2 armor
[*]Allies in the aura get +1 armor[/list] 
[*]Core Hammer [i](Offensive Software)[/i]
[list][*]Now grants the owner a stronger bonus than their allies
[*]The owner gets +10% auto-attack damage
[*]Allies in the aura get +5% auto-attack damage[/list]
[*]Core Drive [i](Propulsion Software)[/i]
[list][*]Now grants the owner a stronger bonus than their allies
[*]The owner gets +1.4m/s speed
[*]Allies in the aura get +0.7m/s speed[/list][/list]
[h1]Pilot Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Fury
[list][*]Lowered her base speed by 0.25m/s (She now has the same base speed as other gunners: 9m/s)[/list]
[*]Pandora
[list][*]Litany of Plagues no longer damages friendly units. Friendly units within Litany of Plagues will still be affected by debuffs
[*]Liberation, Pandora's passive trait, will search for nearby allies within 25m, down from 30m previously
[*]Liberation now grants %-based bonuses. When no allied rigs are within 25m of Pandora, she will regenerate 0.75% of her max HP every second, and gains 9% auto attack damage[/list]
[*]Fury's Special Move: Stunning Entry
[list][*]Reduced the width of Stunning Entry from 7.5m to 4.5m. Decal updated to more accurately depict the AoE (both length and width)[/list]
[*]Recon's Special Move: Orbital Strike
[list][*]Now ignores armor[/list]
[*]Widget's Special Move: Rapid Repairs
[list][*]Duration increased from 6s to 8s[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]The ‘Pilot Locked In’ symbol in draft has been changed from a checkmark to a lock to differentiate it from the ‘Player Ready’ checkmark
[*]There is now a banner that displays when a player drops from a 2v2 or 3v3 match to better inform players that the AI has taken over for a teammate
[*]A reload animation has been added to Laser Lens’ auto attacks to more clearly show when the next attack is ready 
[*]Global Chat Language Room choice is now saved as a local preference when the dropdown is changed, unless Dropzone is specifically booted up in a different language than the one set in the chat[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where a crash would occur if a beam was active when a player chose to resume a 1 player mode after finishing a Multiplayer Match
[*]Fixed an issue where issuing commands with the mouse on top of the Ping Guide in Team Modes resulted in the commands being ordered in incorrect places
[*]Fixed an issue where the Party UI would flicker if the player hovered their cursor over the Party Leader’s crown
[*]Fixed an issue where the Match Results graph would split into multiple lines in 3v3 matches, as if each player were on their own team. These graphs are now properly team-based for both teams
[*]Fixed an issue where vision granted by M.A.S.R. Flare was not shown on the minimap on the Player 2 side in replays
[*]Fixed an issue where disconnecting and reconnecting to a 2v2 match could result in the AI not properly shutting off and still having control of the player’s rigs
[*]Fixed an issue where the in-game chat log could overlap with the text field when a lot of text was displayed
[*]Fixed an issue where no negative sound effect played when a unit was issued a move command or tried to use a movement ability while rooted 
[*]Fixed an issue where using Alt + 4 would upgrade the Rig in Position 1 of your squad
[*]Fixed an issue where ability FX would not reposition correctly if units were relocated via abilities like Palm Rockets
[*]Fixed an issue where turrets in Infestation mode could not be hooked by Palm Rockets
[*]Fixed an issue where the resolution scaling setting was not defaulting to off / disabled properly
[*]Fixed an issue where Observers in Custom Lobby matches would see the ‘Skip Draft’ option during the Drafting sequence
[*]Fixed an issue where the Crazed Banshee missile would skip while in transit to its target
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability decal for Cortex’s Nanite Ray was incorrect
[*]Fixed an issue where the Fog of War checkbox in Replays was not toggling the Fog of War settings correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where the Kavash Alpha in the first tutorial would not spawn correctly if Recon was spamming Stealth Plating
[*]Fixed an issue where the Crazed Banshee ammo explosion FX did not play if it impacted with a Rig equipped with Shielded Actuators if the shield was active
[*]Fixed an issue where hitting Esc to close In-Game chat would not properly clear the unsent message
[*]Fixed an issue where an enemy unit’s hover pulse appeared as if the enemy unit was deselected when confirming an auto attack
[*]Fixed an issue where party members would not match if a party member had one region selected but the party host had more than one region selected
[*]Fixed an issue where a player could open their Profile menu after accepting a match, causing their screen to be obstructed by the Profile menu for the duration of the Draft
[*]Fixed an issue that was allowing a Party of two or three to attempt to seek for 1v1 Unranked, which would cause an Invalid Parameters message
[*]Minor localization fixes
[*]Minor SFX fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

We look forward to hearing your feedback on update v1989, Commanders!

[*]Fixed an issue where issuing commands with the mouse on top of the Ping Guide in Team Modes resulted in the commands being ordered in incorrect places
[*]Fixed an issue where the Party UI would flicker if the player hovered their cursor over the Party Leader’s crown
[*]Fixed an issue where the Match Results graph would split into multiple lines in 3v3 matches, as if each player were on their own team. These graphs are now properly team-based for both teams
[*]Fixed an issue where vision granted by M.A.S.R. Flare was not shown on the minimap on the Player 2 side in replays
[*]Fixed an issue where disconnecting and reconnecting to a 2v2 match could result in the AI not properly shutting off and still having control of the player’s rigs
[*]Fixed an issue where the in-game chat log could overlap with the text field when a lot of text was displayed
[*]Fixed an issue where no negative sound effect played when a unit was issued a move command or tried to use a movement ability while rooted 
[*]Fixed an issue where using Alt + 4 would upgrade the Rig in Position 1 of your squad
[*]Fixed an issue where ability FX would not reposition correctly if units were relocated via abilities like Palm Rockets
[*]Fixed an issue where turrets in Infestation mode could not be hooked by Palm Rockets
[*]Fixed an issue where the resolution scaling setting was not defaulting to off / disabled properly
[*]Fixed an issue where Observers in Custom Lobby matches would see the ‘Skip Draft’ option during the Drafting sequence
[*]Fixed an issue where the Crazed Banshee missile would skip while in transit to its target
[*]Fixed an issue where the ability decal for Cortex’s Nanite Ray was incorrect
[*]Fixed an issue where the Fog of War checkbox in Replays was not toggling the Fog of War settings correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where the Kavash Alpha in the first tutorial would not spawn correctly if Recon was spamming Stealth Plating
[*]Fixed an issue where the Crazed Banshee ammo explosion FX did not play if it impacted with a Rig equipped with Shielded Actuators if the shield was active
[*]Fixed an issue where hitting Esc to close In-Game chat would not properly clear the unsent message
[*]Fixed an issue where an enemy unit’s hover pulse appeared as if the enemy unit was deselected when confirming an auto attack
[*]Fixed an issue where party members would not match if a party member had one region selected but the party host had more than one region selected
[*]Fixed an issue where a player could open their Profile menu after accepting a match, causing their screen to be obstructed by the Profile menu for the duration of the Draft
[*]Fixed an issue that was allowing a Party of two or three to attempt to seek for 1v1 Unranked, which would cause an Invalid Parameters message
[*]Minor localization fixes
[*]Minor SFX fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

We look forward to hearing your feedback on update v1989, Commanders!

notes.title: Ver. 1955 hotfix (MANUAL UPDATE)
notes.content:
Hey Commanders!

We've rolled out a hotfix to address a few issues, and add a few quality-of-life features to Dropzone. [b]This hotfix requires a manual update[/b], so please follow these steps:

[list][*]In your Steam games library, right-click on Dropzone.
[*]Select "Properties."
[*] On the Local Files tab, click, "Verify Integrity of Game Files."[/list]

That should update your client with the hotfix! Here's the list of fixes and additions:

[h1]Miscellaneous Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Friend Codes shown in the Friends List can now be toggled on or off. You can right-click on your username in the Friends List to toggle displaying your Friend Code. The default is set to ON
[*]A [b]"Report Player"[/b] feature has been added to Global Chat, Party Chat, Custom Lobby Chat, and Direct Messages. If you encounter a player breaking the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/572520/discussions/0/133256959383825867/]Community Guidelines[/url], right-click on their name and click "Report Player" so we can investigate. Abuse of the report function is also against the Community Guidelines, so please use it wisely.
[*]There is now a Global Chat room for every language supported by Dropzone. Players will be defaulted to the correct Global Chat room for their selected language, but you can switch to the chat room for any language by clicking on the Language cog wheel located on the right side of the Global Chat banner
[*]All Dropzone Developers now have a [Dev] tag by their username in Global, Party, and Custom Lobby chat.
[*]In the Watch Menu, you can now search player usernames to find their replays! [/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Cyrillic characters were not appearing correctly in chat
[*]Fixed an issue where the "My Friends" filter in the Watch Menu was taking a long time to load
[*]Fixed a crash that would occur if a tank used Landfall but died before the ability completed
[*]Fixed a crash that would occur if players set as Observers in Custom Lobby games used pings once the match had started[/list]

Please make sure to update your game client, Commanders, and we'll see you on Europa!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v1955
notes.content:
It's our first patch notes after going Free to Play! If you're new to the community, welcome, Commander! :) 

Here at Sparkypants we typically release a game update every week, usually on Wednesdays. Tomorrow, Wednesday, April 19, we will be releasing version 1955, which has a few ability balance changes, some Quality of Life features, and lots of bug fixes!

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[b][u]Gear Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Nanite Ray
[list][*]Collision radius increased from .75 to 1.5
[*]Decal size and actual collision radius are 1:1 now, and should match up much better w/ the FX size[/list][/list]
[b][u]Pilot Changes[/u][/b]
[list][*]Plutus' Special Move: Paradigm Shift
[list][*]Can now be cast on units that are under pathing-restricted motion: Thrusters, Boosters, Momentum Shifter, and Fury's Stunning Entry[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Alpha Phage
[list][*]Now displays AoE on mouseover[/list]
[*]There is now a mute button for in-draft and in-game chat
[list][*]Currently, using the mute option will mute all players on your team (WIP)
[*]Mute options transfer, so if you mute your teammates in draft, they will remain muted once the match starts[/list]
[*]There is no longer a full screen Victory / Defeat screen after a match is completed – players are taken directly to the Match Results screen[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Landfall did not snap to the edge of the navmesh
[*]Fixed an issue where Omnipresence did not snap to the edge of the navmesh
[*]Fixed an issue where Challenges could be issued to Friends that were offline
[*]Fixed an issue where Player Name could display help text in Team Match Modes depending on what the Player’s Name was
[*]Fixed an issue where the Party UI would not update to display a changed username without a client restart 
[*]Fixed an issue where Objective hover tooltips could be shown before Objectives were displayed in the Draft Sequence
[*]Fixed an issue where 3v3 match rewards were incorrectly shown as ‘Ranked Multiplayer Bonus’ in the Match Results screen
[*]Fixed an issue where the Restorative Downlink VFX would stack if multiple units with the software were standing on the same tower 
[*]Fixed an issue where Healthbars would briefly detach from units that took damage while Stealth Plating was active 
[*]Fixed an issue where the quickmatch queue ‘Searching’ bar was overlapping with the 3rd goal in Pilot Contracts on 4k resolution
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3VAI match search setting would get re-enabled in the quickmatch Queue options after a match was completed
[*]Fixed an issue where the gear cards for Summoner’s Husk and Summoner’s Cocoon did not list the rate that stacks were generated
[*]Fixed an issue where the gear card for Resource Redirector did not list the time the unit needed to stand still before the software would activate
[*]Fixed an issue where the gear card for Obscure Vitality did not list its reset cooldown 
[*]Fixed an issue where gear cards for summon abilities like Lapse Generator, Replicating Rifle, and Cloning Laser did not list the summons’ AA range
[*]Fixed an issue where Alpha Phage would continue to play its HP Buff FX after reaching maximum stacks
[*]Fixed an issue where a player could run a pilot contract an additional time without finishing the last session of the contract
[*]Fixed an issue where players could receive dropship healing benefits from an area that didn’t have a dropship on the 4th tutorial
[*]More minor localization fixes
[*]Minor SFX fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)[/list]

Look for this update tomorrow, Commanders, and please let us know your feedback in the forums!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v1933
notes.content:
Wednesday, April 12, Dropzone goes Free to Play! We'll be deploying a new patch alongside it, with a new tutorial campaign, new Daily Bounties to earn rewards, and progression system changes for both new and current players.

Spread the word that Dropzone is going Free to Play, and we'll see you on Europa, Commanders! 

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1] 
[list][*]There is a new Daily Bounty that rewards the player for watching a replay
[*]The AI in 3vAI will no longer pick two of the same pilot 
[list][*]It is still possible for them to pick a pilot and that pilot’s Alter-Ego[/list]
[*]Each of the four missions in the Tutorial Campaign reward a one-time 200 Jovian completion bonus
[*]The ‘1 vs 1 Basics’ tutorial has been replaced with a ‘Match Basics’ tutorial. Players now control 1 rig instead of 3 during this guided match
[*]A new campaign with four training missions has been given to players. This will be delivered as a transmission and will always be available in the Train menu. Each training mission will provide one-time Jovian rewards, as well as specific pieces of gear for the associated class[/list]
[h1]Progression Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Jovian rewards for profile level up have been reduced from 1000 Jovians to 750 Jovians
[*]Each profile level up now rewards 2-3 pieces of gear and software
[list][*]Existing players will receive all pieces of gear and software for each profile level they have earned[/list][/list]
[h1]Pilot Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Widget’s Special Move: Rapid Repairs
[list][*]The FX for Rapid Repairs has been updated and now includes beams that will travel to allies that are being healed so it is clearer who is receiving the healing benefits while the Special Move is active[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]There is now a Quickmatch button in the top UI 
[*]Custom Lobbies now support 3v3 Mode
[*]Custom Lobbies now support Ranked Draft mode
[*]Custom Lobbies now support AI difficulty
[*]Party System now includes a ‘Busy’ state when some of your party are still in a match without you, and the ability to rescind pending invites
[*]The Ready Up phase of the Drafting sequence has been changed – the Ready Up button has been removed and the final countdown has changed from 60 seconds to 20 seconds 
[*]1v1 Ranked Leaderboard is now available 
[*]There is a new user option in the Graphics tab that allows users to enable or disable resolution scaling
[*]Players can no longer send challenge requests while in a Party
[*]Players that accept a challenge request while in a Party will now leave their Party
[*]Chat System UI and Friends List have new SFX
[*]Match Chat message count has been lowered to 6 to prevent chat messages obscuring the screen
[*]Players that accept a Party invite from a Party that is already seeking will join the party and the seek will be automatically canceled
[*]While in a party, the ‘Start Search’ button will now be locked if any members of the party are busy – this button will unlock when all party members are no longer busy[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a Server Error that would occur for Party Members if the Party Leader did not respond to a Match Found check
[*]Fixed an issue where game updated messages were showing ‘null’ for all Pilot Names in matches that had more than 1 human on a team
[*]Fixed an issue where Ground Pounder’s FX trail would appear over chasms
[*]Fixed an issue where player hotkeys were not mapped correctly in 3v3 replays
[*]Fixed some issues with key colors on supported color keyboards
[*]Fixed an issue where the Sideboard Phase of the Ranked Draft sequence was allowing players to add 2 pieces of the same software to a pilot with two of the same software slots
[*]Fixed an issue where players were not warned that they would leave their party if they attempted to play a solo mode before the party had started seeking
[*]Fixed an issue where Shielded Actuators FX was not looping properly
[*]Fixed an issue where Crazed Banshee’s targeting FX did not scale for the Kavash Boss
[*]Fixed an issue where the Watch Mode sometimes would not refresh when re-opened
[*]Fixed an issue where units in stasis could be targeted with teleport abilities, but would not teleport
[*]Fixed an issue where the ‘[Player Name] is picking Pilot’ phase was inconsistent per player during 3VAI matches
[*]Fixed an issue where being pushed off the uplink with a Nanite Wall resulted in the unit being unable to upload again until they moved away from the uplink and back to it  
[*]Fixed an issue where playing and finishing a Solo VS AI game while in queue without a match being found resulted in the ‘Start Search’ button appearing red, despite the player still being in queue 
[*]Fixed an issue where a member of a 2 or 3 person party was not removed properly if they started a solo-style game or began watching a replay before party match-seeking had begun
[*]Fixed an issue where party members that were still on the Match Results screen after a match were not properly shown as busy
[*]Fixed an issue where a party member could resign from a match and start searching for a new match before other party members had returned from the match
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3v3 Match Results timeline displayed 3 icons for each map objective earned, causing the icon to be obscured
[*]Fixed an issue where other match mode check boxes could not be clicked if the player was already searching for a match 
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3rd Tutorial could get into a state where the player could not pan the camera
[*]A large amount of localization has been added for all languages[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)

notes.title: Team 3v3 mode is LIVE!
notes.content:
Commanders, yesterday we released our first major game update, bringing a ton of new features and content to Dropzone! This update includes two new modes: Team 3v3, and Ranked 1v1. Today, we'll be talking about everything you need to know to start playing Team 3v3 matches! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/7ce13f76442418c86255c61dddc675d4afd093d7.png[/img]

[h1]Team 3v3 Rules[/h1]

In Team 3v3, your squad is made up of 3 players, each controlling 1 rig. You and your teammates can fight against human opponents, or against the AI. You can also play solo with a team of AI companions against a computer-controlled team.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/054211c132f3db159ca726b182518ad03c1715ba.jpg[/img]

The rules are the same as a standard Dropzone match: you have 15 minutes to score as many points as possible! Whichever team has the most points at the end of 15 minutes wins the match! If you're brand new to Dropzone, you may want to read our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=875313115]Gameplay Basics[/url] guide for more info.

[h1]Selecting your Pilot[/h1]

During the draft phase, each player selects their pilot. You can choose from any of the pilots you currently have unlocked, from any of your saved squads. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/6044b601958d31f8bda5979bdaef5898774a5e32.jpg[/img] 

[h1]Shared XP Gain[/h1]

Unlike a 1v1 Dropzone match where you must choose which of your 3 rigs to allocate XP to, all players accrue shared experience by killing Kavash units, and level up at the same rate. Use this to your advantage, Commander!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/851c05e6b121a4c16516496cd5daef00ccfc1af3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Multi-queue[/h1]

With this update, we've made it even easier to find a match in Dropzone. You can now queue for multiple game types, including Team 3v3! You can select whether you want to join players in a battle against humans, AI, or queue for both. You can also queue in multiple regions to team up with Dropzone players around the world!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/67259661ffac304c02e9eae95675ce4297cec0db.jpg[/img]

[h1]Party System[/h1]

Find a group of players that you want to keep rolling with? Now you can queue with the same group of players using the new Party System! Use the Party Chat feature to plan your team strategy while you queue for a match. You can add players to your Party from your in-game Friends List, or through Global Chat.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/2a9b4c706289220aa26cd14e2120a45879f5694e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dropzone going Free to Play April 12! Exclusive bundles now on SALE![/h1]

Have some friends who haven't yet joined the core hunt in Dropzone? Now's the perfect time to get them into the game with the release of Team 3v3!  

From now until the launch of F2P on April 12, it's your LAST CHANCE to pick up the EXCLUSIVE Squad and Commander Editions on Steam at huge discounts. Don't miss out! (Click the image for bundle details.)

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/3844b09193fdb986d46ea7ddcc892199e11af389.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/3844b09193fdb986d46ea7ddcc892199e11af389.png[/img][/url]

See you (and your teammates!) on Europa, Commanders!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v1889
notes.content:
[b]"Update 7 - Join the Battle"[/b]
[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1] 
[u][i]New Features[/i][/u]
[list][*]Team 3v3 Mode
[list][*]Everything you love about Dropzone, now with friends! You and two allied Commanders will each take control of 1 Rig to form a squad of 3, in a 15-minute match against three human opponents or the AI
[*]Control 1 Rig on a team of 3, and fight against a team of 3 human opponents
[*]Join 2 other human players in a match against an AI team 
[*]Play solo, forming a team with AI companions in a match against a computer-controlled team
[*]Gameplay seamlessly continues if a player drops out, as an AI takes over for that player
[*]Teammates share XP, vision, and objective points
[*]Team chat available in-game and during draft[/list][/list]
[list][*]Ranked Play
[list][*]Ranked 1v1 is the ultimate test of skill for seasoned Dropzone players!
[*]Pick your favorite Pilots during the draft phase! No duplicate pilots allowed, so pick wisely
[*]The Sideboard feature allows you to preemptively put aside 10 pieces of gear in preparation to counter your opponents pilot and gear selection during the Edit Gear phase of the draft
[*]Leaderboard to be hooked up for Ranked play soon. All match history will be preserved and taken into account when leaderboard is hooked up
[*]Ranked 1v1 Divisions and Reputation Points system coming soon
[*]Ranked Draft option in Custom Lobbies is WIP and will be arriving next week [/list][/list]
[list][*]Multi-queueing 
[list][*]Search for Team matches (versus Human or AI), Player vs Player matches (Ranked or Unranked), or any combination of the four
[*]Select multiple network regions in which to search for matches
[*]Infestation multi-queueing coming soon[/list][/list]
[list][*]Party System
[list][*]Form a persistent Party with up to two other players (friends or chat acquaintances) and search the queue for team matches
[*]Any member of the party can initiate match seeking, but only the Party leader can add or remove members
[*]Once a Party is created, chat privately in your own Party Chat window and build your rigs together to form the best winning strategy
[*]All members must be at the Main Menu before a Party Seek is initiated 
[*]If a party member resigns from a match, they will see their other members as “busy” until they finish or leave that current game (WIP)
[*]Any party member that starts a solo-style match or watches a replay before seeking begins will be removed from the party (WIP) [/list][/list]
[u][i]Gameplay Changes[/i][/u]
[list][*]Base Armor Changes (Kavash)
[list][*]Kavash Worker - Base armor increased from 0 to 2
[*]Kavash Soldier - Base armor increased from 0 to 2
[*]Kavash Kamikaze - Base armor increased from 0 to 2[/list][/list]
[list][*]Base HP Changes (Kavash)
[list][*]Kavash Worker - Base health reduced from 120 to 110
[*]Kavash Soldier - Base health reduced from 400 to 375
[*]Kavash Goblin - Base health reduced from 500 to 400
[*]Kavash Kamikaze - Base health reduced from 200 to 185[/list][/list]
[list][*]Detection and Cloaking
[list][*]Owned Vision Towers now have an inherent 15m detection radius for their owner's team
[*]MASR Flare has a 15m detection radius
[*]Goons/Totems created by Replicating Rifle, Cloning Laser, Plasma Drone, Nanite Wall, Lapse Generator all have 10m detection radii
[*]Cloaked units that take damage will be detected by the team that damaged them for 2s
[*]This does not decloak the cloaked pilot, merely detects them briefly
[*]You still need some source of LOS to the cloaked unit to see them even if they're detected[/list][/list]
[list][*]Vision Towers
[list][*]ALL teams now have detection on the Vision Tower's plate, regardless of whether or not they own the tower.
[*]They do not have vision around the Vision Tower unless they actually own it[/list][/list]
[list][*]Alt-Click Pings
[list][*]Players can now alt-click Pilot and Match UI elements to alert their team
[*]Alt-clicking the Pilot Portrait or Tab will alert allies of your health level when you rig is alive, and your respawn timer when your rig is dead
[*]Alt-clicking abilities will alert allies of your ability status, whether it is locked, on cooldown, or ready to use
[*]Players can alt-click the match timer to alert allies of the current time
[*]Players can alt-click objectives to alert allies of the objective availability[/list][/list]
[list][*]Skylance now has team colored FX
[*]Drone Strikes now has team colored FX[/list]
[u][i]Gear Changes[/i][/u]
[list][*]Palm Rockets
[list][*]Replicating Rifle Turrets, Plasma Drone, Lapse Generator minions are now ignored by the hook
[*]Kavash workers and soldiers are now ignored by the hook[/list][/list]
[list][*]Acid Cannon
[list][*]Now does DPS to units in the acid
[*]Ability DPS rescaled from 0 to 40
[*]Unlock level increased from 2 to 3
[*]Armor debuff rescaled from 0/5/10/15/15 to 0/0/5/10/15[/list][/list]
[list][*]Atomic Welder
[list][*]Unlock level lowered from 3 to 2
[*]Cooldown rescaled from 8s to 0/16/8/8/8[/list][/list]
[list][*]Inhibitor Field
[list][*]Now does damage at the same time it applies the disarm debuff
[*]Burst damage increased from 0 to 100[/list][/list]
[list][*]Null Field
[list][*]Ability DPS increased from 30 to 45[/list][/list]
[list][*]M.A.S.R. Flare
[list][*]The flare can now be seen by the opponent before they enter its LOS. Previously you had to be within the LOS range of the flare before its particle FX would render[/list][/list]
[list][*]Napalm Canisters
[list][*]Unlock level lowered from 3 to 2
[*]Stacks per cast rescaled from 1 to 0/1/2/3/3
[*]Now adds additional stacks of slag for each cast as the gear is upgraded[/list][/list]
[list][*]Hive Link
[list][*]Unlock level increased from 2 to 3
[*]Cooldown at level 3 unchanged at 16s[/list][/list]
[list][*]Radar Mapping
[list][*]No longer grants detection when the Tank casts a spell
[*]Now grants a LOS boost when the Tank casts a spell
[*]0 / 15 / 30 / 45 / 45 LOS. Buff lasts for 8s[/list][/list]
[list][*]Argus Routine
[list][*]No longer grants detection when standing on the VT plate
[*]Now grants a large amount of extra LOS (+105 vs the Vision Tower's normal +68) when standing on the friendly Vision Tower's plate[/list][/list]
[list][*]Resource Redirector
[list][*]Redesigned
[*]No longer grants a flat damage bonus
[*]No longer affects Kavash units
[*]Now grants 10% of the target's current HP as bonus weapon damage. (The more HP the target currently has, the more bonus damage)
[*]Activation time lowered from 3s to 2s
[*]Unlock level unchanged[/list][/list]
[u][i]Pilot Changes[/i][/u]
[list][*]Base Armor Changes
[list][*]Tank - Base armor reduced from 17 to 12
[*]Gunner - Base armor reduced from 12 to 8
[*]Mechanic - Base armor reduced from 13 to 6
[*]Summoner - Base armor reduced from 11 to 5[/list][/list]
[list][*]Base HP Changes
[list][*]Tank - Base health increased from 700 to 775
[*]Gunner - Base health increased from 500 to 550
[*]Mechanic - Base health increased from 575 to 700
[*]Summoner - Base health increased from 450 to 550[/list][/list]
[list][*]Recon’s Trait
[list][*]Armor debuff max stacks reduced from 3 to 2
[*]Max armor debuff changed from -6 to -4[/list][/list]
[list][*]Vanguard’s Trait
[list][*]Armor aura reduced from 4 to 3[/list][/list]
[list][*]Vanguard’s Special Move: Angel of Mercy
[list][*]Can now be targeted on an enemy unit
[*]Tether break rules are the same as before, and the tether will now break if Vanguard loses sight of her target
[*]Cooldown increased from 50 to 80
[*]Cast range reduced from 70 to 50[/list][/list]
[list][*]Knockout’s Special Move: Haymaker
[list][*]Cast point moved from 0ms to 450ms
[*]Recovery time unchanged at 1000ms
[*]No longer snares the targeted unit immediately, it now waits for damage at the 450ms release event to start the knockback
[*]The punch now has a range of 15m, units that get far enough away from Knockout during the windup will avoid the punch
[*]The cast point and punch now occur on the same frame, so it’s impossible to burn the cooldown without delivering a punch[/list][/list]
[list][*]Warhead’s Special Move: Encase
[list][*]Cast point changed from 0ms to 600ms
[*]Recovery time unchanged at 1200ms
[*]The cast point and the damage now occur on the same frame, so it’s impossible to burn the cooldown without delivering the ability’s effect[/list][/list]
[list][*]Turbine’s Special Move: Stoke the Fire
[list][*]HP Drain no longer escalates over time, now maintains a constant value
[*]Total HP Drain over 10s reduced from 440 to 220[/list][/list]
[list][*]Pandora’s Special Move: Litany of Plagues
[list][*]Cast point moved to 500ms
[*]You are now guaranteed to get the first burst of damage when the cooldown is burned[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Builder Changes
[list][*]Pilots are now displayed on the left portion of the screen in a grid layout
[*]All players have received a 4th squad. This 4th squad is a dedicated Ranked squad and cannot be used in non-ranked modes
[*]When the Ranked squad is selected, an "Edit Sideboard" button will appear under the gear list module[/list][/list][list][*]The Match Found notification no longer has a decline option
[*]Challenge Matches will now send both the Challenger and Challengee a Match Found check when the challenge is accepted 
[*]The Watch List has been updated to include a 3v3 sorting tab
[*]Updated menu flow reflects new modes and changes to Dropzone
[*]Multiplayer Pings have been iterated on but are still WIP 
[*]Global Chat is now located on the bottom right side of the screen, next to the new Party UI[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Crumple Panels’ SFX was not looping correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where Plasma Rifle did not display a Command Grid icon when amplified
[*]Fixed an issue where Cleansing Cells debuff immunity status was not using the correct icon
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could use Stealth Plating to skip a step that involved casting Rocket Cluster on an Alpha
[*]Fixed a pathing issue in ‘A Surprise Encounter’ – issuing a ‘Back to Base’ after the rescue dropship has landed will send all units to the dropship
[*]Fixed an issue where the full-body animation on the Tank wasn't playing when Momentum Shifter was cast
[*]Fixed an issue where Regenerative Layering’s stack would not go to 0 upon death
[*]Fixed an issue where Amoeba Protocol continued to play the HP Buff FX after earning maximum stacks
[*]Fixed an issue where special characters were not displayed correctly in the name change text field of account settings
[*]Fixed an issue where the Palm Rockets chain was not displaying correctly in replays
[*]Fixed an issue where the Laser Lens hit FX would play on the rig much later than when the damage was done
[*]Fixed an issue where Crazed Banshee’s targeting FX would persist on the target if the projectile never impacted
[*]Fixed an issue where Landfall’s gear card did not mention the ability’s windup
[*]Minor localization and text fixes[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]If a player under Level 15 navigates through the Play Menu and selects Ranked: Player VS Player, the quick match queue will open and appear as if it searching for a Ranked Match when it is not, as the player has not met the Ranked level requirement
[*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Sideboard Phase of 1v1 Ranked Draft is not preventing double software from being selected on Pilots with two of the same software slots. If confirmed, software selection will revert to previous loadout
[*]The Watch Menu does not refresh when you access the Watch Menu a second time via the Watch Button on the Main Menu. You must click through the game mode tabs to refresh the list 
[*]Party members that did not initiate a seek will see incorrect checkboxes sometimes (WIP)
[*]All the new Play flow menus and new game mode menus still need translation for every language except English and German[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes v1840
notes.content:
Time for patch notes! This week, rig base speed and HP scaling for all classes is getting rebalanced, and we're adjusting Fury's and Plutus' passive traits. We're also reducing the amount of healing per second Healing Dome deals. (As some of you commented in the past week, it was just too strong!)

Update 1840 will deploy on Wednesday, March 29.

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[b]Gear Changes[/b]
[list][*]Healing Dome
[list][*]Healing per second reduced from 200 to 150[/list][/list]
[b]Pilot Changes[/b]
[list][*]Tank Base Speed
[list][*]Vise: Increased from 7.0 to 7.75
[*]Warhead: Increased from 7.0 to 7.75
[*]Knockout: Increased from 5.75 to 6.75[/list]
[*]Gunner Base Speed
[list][*]Recon: Increased from 8.0 to 9.0
[*]Vanguard: Increased from 8.0 to 9.0
[*]Fury: Increased from 8.25 to 9.25[/list]
[*]Summoner Base Speed
[list][*]Base speed for all Summoners increased from 7.0 to 8.0[/list]
[*]Mechanic Base Speed
[list][*]Base speed for all Mechanics increased from 7.0 to 8.0[/list]
[*]HP Scaling
[list][*]All Rigs: 0/200/400/450/500 rescaled to 0/200/350/450/500[/list]
[*]Additional Tank HP scaling
[list][*]Reduced from 0/0/0/75/150 to 0/0/0/0/0[/list]
[*]Additional Mechanic HP scaling
[list][*]Reduced from 0/0/0/50/75 to 0/0/0/0/0[/list]
[*]Fury's Trait
