notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes v1813
notes.content:
Happy Monday, Commanders! You may recall that last week we postponed version 1790 to make sure that the patch met our high standards of quality; on Wednesday, March 22, we will be releasing version 1813, which is an updated and polished version of the 1790 patch notes. 

There are some differences from last week's notes (most notably gear changes), so be sure to read through them! 

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[b]Unranked Draft update[/b]
[list][*]The unranked draft sequence now allows players to select any of their three saved squad loadouts to bring into the match. This was one of our most requested additions from players, so let us know what you think of it!
[list][*]Players have up to 1 minute to select and lock in their squads. The timer will end once both players have locked in their squads. (This timer also accounts for time passed while the draft is initiating, and while the dropships are flying into place)
[*]After players have locked in their squads, another 60 second countdown timer will start – this countdown timer will update to 10 seconds remaining if all players click ‘Ready Up’[/list][/list]
[b]Account Settings / Account Rename[/b]
[list][*]All players have been given 1 name token to change their account name if they wish to do so
[*]This setting can be found by clicking on the Player Portrait and navigating to ‘Account Settings’. Type in your desired name, (no more than 16 characters allowed), and click ‘SAVE NAME’[/list]
[h1]Gear Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Assault Plasma
[list][*]The gunner will now halt orders after using the active ability, instead of resuming movement. Now the gunner will start AA immediately after activation is complete[/list]
[*]Scatter Laser
[list][*]The gunner will now halt orders after using the active ability, instead of resuming movement. Now the gunner will start AA immediately after activation is complete[/list]
[*]Scatter Blaster
[list][*]The gunner will now halt orders after using the active ability, instead of resuming movement. Now the gunner will start AA immediately after activation is complete[/list]
[*]Ground Pounder
[list][*]Ability damage increased from 150 to 250[/list]
[*]Pulse Cannons
[list][*]Cooldown reduced from 60s to 40s
[*]Ability damage increased from 100 to 200[/list]
[*]Surge Amplifier
[list][*]Cooldown reduced from 35s to 28s[/list]
[*]Cleansing Cells
[list][*]Debuff immunity increased from 3s to 4.5s[/list]
[*]Null Field
[list][*]DPS reduced from 50/60/80 to 30[/list]
[*]Quantum Mire
[list][*]Recovery time reduced from 1000ms to 600ms[/list]
[*]Inhibitor Field
[list][*]Recovery time reduced from 1000ms to 350ms[/list]
[*]Nanite Wall
[list][*]Duration reduced from 8s to 6s
[*]Cast Range changed from 40m to --/--/23/28/33m
[*]Recovery time reduced from 1300ms to 900ms
[*]The ammo that spawns the wall now travels at 40m/s rather than taking 0.35s to arrive at the destination[/list]
[*]Reconstructive Maneuver
[list][*]Cast Range changed from 40m to --/--/20/30/40m[/list]
[*]Dyno Vortex
[list][*]Pull radius changed 20/25/30 to 25
[*]Unlock Level raised from 2 to 3[/list]
[*]Grav Engine
[list][*]Pull radius change from 35 to 30
[*]Unlock level raised from 4 to 5
[*]Now applies a 2-second -30% Armor debuff to units that are pulled, applied after the pull is complete[/list]
[*]One of Us
[list][*]One of Us bonus is conveyed to any summoned Kavash minions, such as ones from Lapse Generator
[*]Gear card text updated to mention this new effect[/list][/list]
[h1]Pilot Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Plutus’ Special Move: Paradigm Shift 
[list][*]Cooldown reduced from 60s to 40s
[*]Cast Range increased from 25 to 35m[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Cloning Laser
[list][*]Gear Card text has been updated to mention that destroyed turrets cannot clone themselves[/list]
[*]Power Shunts
[list][*]Gear Card text has been updated to mention that the ability cooldown cannot be modified[/list]
[*]Landfall
[list][*]Gear Card text has been updated to mention the windup before the jump[/list]
[*]Turbine’s Special Move: Stoke the Fire
[list][*]Ability text has been updated to mention HP Drain instead of Self Damage. Text also updated to mention drain cannot be modified by things like armor, etc.[/list]
[*]Various pieces of gear have had their builder FX and SFX updated[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a crash that would occur when Palm Rocketing a Vision Tower or Uplink while tank was rooted
[*]The navmesh on A Surprise Encounter has been updated to fix an issue where units could clip inside of map elements
[*]Fixed an issue where the minimap on Mind the Gap did not display cross/health icons in the dropships
[*]Fixed an issue where the Kavash Soldier auto attack animation did not transition back to an idle animation immediately after completing
[*]Fixed an issue where pressing Tab in the Password Protect field of a Custom Lobby would move the cursor to the Custom Lobby name field and not tab back to the Password Protect text field if pressed again
[*]Fixed an issue where Fog of War controls were featured in Infestation Replays. This toggle is now hidden in Infestation replays 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Searching bar overlapped the ‘Return to Builder’ button in Sandbox Mode
[*]Fixed an issue where the Dropship Vision was misplaced on Mind the Gap
[*]Fixed an issue where Icebreaker’s map name featured (2v2) in the Draft Sequence
[*]Fixed an issue where the ‘Current Squad’ button did not play hover or select SFX
[*]Fixed an issue where Summoner’s Cocoon was not stacking properly until the original stack was removed
[*]Fixed an issue where Transmission SFX for cards was not matching the movement of the tiles
[*]Fixed an issue where no SFX played when selecting a Pilot in the Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where Transmissions did not play hover SFX
[*]Fixed an issue where the ‘Close’ button on the Transmission Details panel did not play click SFX
[*]Fixed an issue where 16 character names were cut off in the Custom Lobby screen and Friends List 
[*]Fixed an issue where Daredevil Recon’s Orbital Strike did not play SFX when activated in the Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where Quantum Leap would fail to teleport to targets that were off the navmesh. Now it searches for a valid position 30 meters around the target to teleport to
[*]Fixed an issue where Landfall would continue its windup after being rooted. Being rooted will now interrupt Landfall but the cooldown for Landfall won’t be consumed since its being interrupted before the cast point
[*]Fixed an issue where Scoring Points and Battle Tactics would show match score and timer UI elements during the elevator sequence
[*]Fixed an issue where Crazed Banshee’s targeting FX would persist on the target if the projectile expired before impact
[*]Fixed an issue where the Transmissions list was partially cut off if the player had more than 4 transmissions
[*]Fixed an issue where Crazed Banshee’s projectile would disappear but continue to show propellant flames
[*]More minor language localization fixes have been added
[*]Fixed a crash that would occur for the sender of a challenge request if the recipient declined
[*]Fixed an issue where Recon’s passive was not stacking correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where the ‘Reset Hotkeys’ option was not correctly resetting changed hotkeys
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game[/list]

Let us know your thoughts on the forums, Commanders!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v1790
notes.content:
Patch notes for upcoming version 1790, Commanders! Stay tuned for a message on when this patch will release.

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[b]Unranked Draft update[/b]
[list][*]The unranked draft sequence now allows players to select any of their three saved squad loadouts to bring into the match. This was one of our most requested additions from players, so let us know what you think of it!
[list][*]Players have up to 1 minute to select and lock in their squads. The timer will end once both players have locked in their squads. (This timer also accounts for time passed while the draft is initiating, and while the dropships are flying into place)
[*]After players have locked in their squads, another 60 second countdown timer will start – this countdown timer will update to 10 seconds remaining if all players click ‘Ready Up’[/list][/list]
[b]Account Settings / Account Rename[/b]
[list][*]All players have been given 1 name token to change their account name if they wish to do so
[*]This setting can be found by clicking on the Player Portrait and navigating to ‘Account Settings’. Type in your desired name, (no more than 16 characters allowed), and click ‘SAVE NAME’[/list]
[h1]Gear Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Assault Plasma
[list][*]The gunner will now halt orders after using the active ability, instead of resuming movement. Now the gunner will start AA immediately after activation is complete[/list]
[*]Scatter Laser
[list][*]The gunner will now halt orders after using the active ability, instead of resuming movement. Now the gunner will start AA immediately after activation is complete[/list]
[*]Scatter Blaster
[list][*]The gunner will now halt orders after using the active ability, instead of resuming movement. Now the gunner will start AA immediately after activation is complete[/list]
[*]Null Field
[list][*]DPS reduced from 50/60/80 to 30[/list]
[*]Reconstructive Maneuver
[list][*]Taking damage from an enemy Rig will put the ability on cooldown for 1s[/list]
[*]Dyno Vortex
[list][*]Pull radius changed 20/25/30 to 20
[*]Unlock Level raised from 2 to 3
[*]No longer affects units that are uplinking[/list]
[*]Grav Engine
[list][*]Pull radius change from 35 to 20
[*]Unlock level raised from 4 to 5
[*]Now applies a 2-second -30% Armor debuff to units that are pulled, applied after the pull is complete
[*]No longer affects units that are uplinking[/list]
[*]One of Us
[list][*]One of Us bonus is conveyed to any summoned Kavash minions, such as ones from Lapse Generator
[*]Gear card text updated to mention this new effect[/list][/list]
[h1]Pilot Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Plutus’ Special Move: Paradigm Shift 
[list][*]Cooldown reduced from 60s to 40s
[*]Cast Range increased from 25 to 35m[/list][/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Cloning Laser
[list][*]Gear Card text has been updated to mention that destroyed turrets cannot clone themselves[/list]
[*]Power Shunts
[list][*]Gear Card text has been updated to mention that the ability cooldown cannot be modified[/list]
[*]Landfall
[list][*]Gear Card text has been updated to mention the windup before the jump[/list]
[*]Turbine’s Special Move: Stoke the Fire
[list][*]Ability text has been updated to mention HP Drain instead of Self Damage. Text also updated to mention drain cannot be modified by things like armor, etc.[/list]
[*]Various pieces of gear have had their builder FX and SFX updated[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a crash that would occur when Palm Rocketing a Vision Tower or the Uplink while the tank was rooted
[*]Fixed an issue where pressing Tab in the Password Protect field of a Custom Lobby would move the cursor to the Custom Lobby name field and not tab back to the Password Protect text field if pressed again
[*]Fixed an issue where Fog of War controls were featured in Infestation Replays. This toggle is now hidden in Infestation replays 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Searching bar overlapped the ‘Return to Builder’ button in Sandbox Mode
[*]Fixed an issue where the Dropship Vision was misplaced on Mind the Gap
[*]Fixed an issue where Icebreaker’s map name featured (2v2) in the Draft Sequence
[*]Fixed an issue where the ‘Current Squad’ button did not play hover or select SFX
[*]Fixed an issue where Summoner’s Cocoon was not stacking properly until the original stack was removed
[*]Fixed an issue where Transmission SFX for cards was not matching the movement of the tiles
[*]Fixed an issue where no SFX played when selecting a Pilot in the Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where Transmissions did not play hover SFX
[*]Fixed an issue where the ‘Close’ button on the Transmission Details panel did not play click SFX
[*]Fixed an issue where 16 character names were cut off in the Custom Lobby screen and Friends List 
[*]Fixed an issue where Daredevil Recon’s Orbital Strike did not play SFX when activated in the Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where Quantum Leap would fail to teleport to targets that were off the navmesh. Now it searches for a valid position 30 meters around the target to teleport to
[*]Fixed an issue where Landfall would continue its windup after being rooted. Being rooted will now interrupt Landfall but the cooldown for Landfall won’t be consumed since its being interrupted before the cast point
[*]Fixed an issue where Scoring Points and Battle Tactics would show match score and timer UI elements during the elevator sequence
[*]Fixed an issue where Crazed Banshee’s targeting FX would persist on the target if the projectile expired before impact
[*]Fixed an issue where the Transmissions list was partially cut off if the player had more than 4 transmissions
[*]Fixed an issue where Crazed Banshee’s projectile would disappear but continue to show propellant flames
[*]More minor language localization fixes have been added[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[*]Momentum Shifter currently does not play its animation, SFX or VFX when activated, but the ability is functioning correctly. A fix is coming in next week's patch

As always, we want to hear your opinions on these changes and additions! Let us know your thoughts here on the forums once the patch drops tomorrow!

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v1742
notes.content:
New patch incoming this Wendesday, March 8, Commanders! 

[h1]Coming soon[/h1]
[list]
[*]The CONTRACT system will be online soon and comes via the Transmission UI! Contracts are limited-time PvE (player vs. environment) missions that strive to show you new aspects of Dropzone, while giving you the chance to show off your skills and collect rewards.
[list]
[*]"Open Season" is a Pandora-focused Contract
[*]There is a 7-minute time limit to complete three goals, each with their own reward:
[list]
[*] Upload 2 Cores (Reward: 500 Jovians)
[*] Upload 4 Cores (Reward: 1,000 Jovians)
[*] Upload 7 Cores and survive (Reward: 2,500 Jovians)[/list][/list][/list]
Feedback on "Open Season" and the Contracts system is welcome and greatly appreciated!

[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Increased minimap ping duration to 5 seconds
[*]Adjusted timing on in-world ping effects for 2v2[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a crash in Infestation matches with a very large number of Kavash
[*]Reduced Dropzone’s memory usage 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Password Protect option in the Custom Lobby screen was using the Private Match tooltip
[*]Fixed an issue where clicking the Jovians amount did not take you to the Shop
[*]Fixed an issue where Builder hotkeys were not blocked while typing in Friend Chat
[*]Fixed an issue where 16 character names were cut off in the Custom Lobby screen
[*]Fixed an issue where players could right-click themselves to produce a chat options menu with no options
[*]Minor language localization fixes have been added
[*]Fixed an issue where the transmissions detail panel had misaligned reward text
[*]Fixed an issue where Fury’s Special Move was causing a brief but severe performance drop for certain players 
[*]Fixed a rare crash where users playing in fullscreen would sometimes alt-tab out of Dropzone then crash when they tried to return[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game[/list]

Let us know your thoughts about this week's update in the forums!

notes.title: Core Hunt Contest
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/6270d1dadd62abf18b1407099f111a78711974b5.jpg[/img]
How would you like to get your hands on a USB Gunner Rig? What about a [url=www.roccat.org]ROCCAT[/url] Kone EMP mouse, a ROCCAT Isku+ Force FX keyboard or a Dropzone T-shirt? 
It’s a battle for cores, Commander, and you need to show us how many you can gather in 15 minutes!
At this point, you’re probably already wondering how to get your hands on these goodies. It’s easy! Here’s what you need to do:

[list][*]Get in the game, play a competitive match against another Commander and fight to upload as many cores as you can.
[*]Once you’re done, take a screenshot of the victory screen.
[*]Send it to coreshunt@playdropzone.com before the 12th of March with the following information:
[list][*]Title: Core Hunt
[*]In-game nickname
[*]Date of the match [/list][/list]
[b]The player with the highest score will win: [/b]
[list][*]A Dropzone USB Gunner Rig
[*]A Dropzone T-shirt
[*]A ROCCAT Kone EMP Mouse[/list]
[b]Second place will receive: [/b]
[list][*]A Dropzone USB Gunner Rig

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v1709
notes.content:
This will hit the live servers tomorrow in course of the day.

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list][*]Jump pads no longer disjoint ammo
[/list][i][u]Gear Changes[/u][/i]
[list][*]Scatter Laser
[list][*]Damage debuff is now 20% at all levels
[*]Ability damage from 50x4 (total) to 28.5 / 37.5 / 50 (x4)
[/list][*]Flamethrower
[list][*]Auto-attack damage reduced from 80/90/100/110/110 to 80/80/80/80/80
[*]Bonus Damage per Slag Stack increased from 0/2.5/2.7/2.9/3.0 to 0/2.8/3.0/3.3/3.5
[*]Auto-attack range reduced from 14m to 13m
[*]Auto-attack splash range reduced from 17m to 16.5m
[*]Release count per auto-attack cycle reduced from 2 to 1. Auto-attack cycle length unchanged. This now applies damage less frequently, but more damage per damage instance
[*]Overall max-stacks amplified DPS changed from: -/173/189/206.5/209.8 to -/173/179.8/189.8/196
[/list][*]Null Field
[list][*]Now has a 1 second delay before it starts silencing and damaging enemies inside the field
[*]Overall duration has increased from 5 seconds to 6 seconds to accommodate the delay
[/list][*]Inhibitor Field
[list][*]The field now lasts for 1 second and no longer disarms enemies inside the field
[*]Instead, enemies inside the field when it ends are disarmed
[*]The disarm lasts for 2.5 seconds
[/list][*]Dyno Vortex
[list][*]Splash size rescaled from --/25/30/35/35 to --/20/25/30/30
[/list][*]Shock Prod
[list][*]Will no longer seek attackers at infinite distances
[*]Seek logic from both the attacker (if present) and fallback nearest enemy logic has been unified to use the displayed search range value
[*]Search range value increased from 20m to 28m
[/list][*]Zealot Drive
[list][*]Reactive HP Regen is added on all enemy damage, instead of just auto-attack damage
[/list][*]Combat Rush
[list][*]Now activates when the gunner auto-attacks while at low HP
[*]The effect lasts for 3 seconds. Attacking will refresh the effect
[*]The potency of the effect is still based on how hurt the gunner is
[/list][*]Obscure Vitality
[list][*]Now works in Infestation Mode
[/list][/list]

[i][u]Pilot Changes[/u][/i]
[list][*]Fury
[list][*]Base speed reduced from 8.5 to 8.25 (Base gunner speed is still 8.0)
[/list][/list]
[list][*]Recon’s Trait
[list][*]Now stacks up to 3 times
[*]Duration does not refresh when stacked
[/list][*]Plutus’ Trait
[list][*]Ally armor bonus reduced from +5 to +3
[*]Enemy armor debuff unchanged (-5)
[/list][/list][b]Miscellaneous Notes[/b]
[list][*]Two new user preferences have been added to the Gameplay tab of the Options menu
[*]The Match Seeking panel has been moved to the bottom replay HUD to prevent UI overlap
[*]The outdated version error text has been updated to make it more clear that the player is on an old version and needs to update
[*]Custom Lobby chat is now automatically opened in mini-state when starting a Custom Lobby
[*]Basic Functionality stats have been moved to the bottom of gear cards
[*]In-game chat for Infestation now reflects each participants’ player color
[*]Friend chat now remembers the history of the chat. Currently, chat notifications are not set up if messages are received while the friend is offline or in the middle of a match - that fix will be added soon
[*]The ‘Continue’ button on the rewards screens now has click SFX
[*]The hologram that displays crafted gear and gear opened in crates has been updated
[*]Streamer safety guides have been added to the installation directory in the community folder. These files point out ‘safe zones’ for players to put their stream information so that it doesn’t overlap with Dropzone’s UI
[/list][b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Player Overview Tab was counting Test Loadout runs in the ‘Matches Played’ category.
[*]Fixed an issue where the camera could become locked in the 3[sup]rd[/sup] Tutorial – Scoring Points
[*]Fixed an issue where the flashing UI box was not properly centered on ‘Return to Builder’ button during the Builder Tutorial
[*]Fixed an issue where ‘Double Kill’ and ‘Team Wipe’ banners were always displaying as blue
[*]Fixed an issue where the Watch Mode HUD toggle was not hiding Infestation UI elements
[*]Fixed an issue where Custom Tower equipped text was displaying as string text
[*]Fixed an issue where Custom Lobby chat was named ‘Dropzone Chat’ – Custom Lobby chat is now named ‘Lobby Chat’
[*]Fixed an issue where double digit pilot levels overlapped with the level progress bar on the match results screen
[*]Fixed an issue where collapsing the chat into a smaller window did not show the most recent messages sent
[*]Fixed an issue where Credits were not accessible after completely playing once
[*]Fixed an issue where the Continue button on the Introduction pop up was not translated for German
[*]Fixed an issue where the Daily Bounty rewards were not listed in the Transmissions Detail panel after skipping the Tutorial
[*]Fixed an issue where chat text was too small in lower resolutions
[*]Added a temp fix to regenerate the default.json file if it ever got into a bad ‘null’ state
[*]Fixed an issue where certain Infestation VO lines only played out of the left speaker
[*]Fixed an issue where Nanite Wall did not block rigs that used Thrusters or Boosters toward it
[*]Fixed a memory crash on Windows 7 and 8 machines
[*]Fixed the vision controls for red/blue team in the bottom left corner of the replay UI. You no longer have to CTRL-CLICK to turn them both on. Both eyes now toggle on and off
[*]Fixed backwards compatibility issue with replays from builds 1635, 1640 and 1661
[*]Fixed Summoner's Cocoon not stacking until the original stack is removed by an attack
[/list][b]Known Issues[/b]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking Observer slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game
[/list]

[list][*]Ally armor bonus reduced from +5 to +3

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v1661
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Notes[/b]
[list][*]Changes have been made to resigning
[list][*]Drops and Resigns after 10 minutes of gameplay now give full rewards. This scales up linearly from 0 to 10 minutes. This will also count for the Daily Bounty ‘Finish 1 Match’
[*]The client will now show a resign pop up when it is mathematically improbable for one player to win. This includes the opponent getting half of all possible points, not enough cores remaining on the map to gain a win, and not enough time to upload cores to win[/list]
[*]Players can now continue to play Solo modes when a new version of the game is released instead of being forced to patch to the latest version.
[*]Infestation
[list][*]Adding extra time between waves as the game goes on. +3 seconds every 5 waves. Up to an additional +20 seconds
[*]Fixing mob spawning rules, ensuring that we cannot spawn more of the hardest wave than of the easier waves
[*]Core dunks are worth 2000 points instead of 5000 points
[*]Increasing hive bucket milestone size by 1 for all player counts, it takes more hives to earn extra events
[*]+1 event card per turn starting at waves 15, 30, and 45. (Wave 45 will be 4 event cards every turn)
[*]Co-op games will increase the maximum hive count every three waves, instead of every two
[*]Co-op games will spawn an extra hive every five waves instead of every four
[*]Solo games will spawn an extra hive every 9th wave (in addition to the extra hive every 4th wave)
[*]Kamikaze Kavash will now detonate on the reactor
[*]Reducing the maximum core bucket milestone size for 4 player, from 6 to 5. (Late game it will only take 5 cores to receive a positive event)
[*]Angel of Mercy event chance increased later in the game
[*]Reduced Boss Surge event chance later in the game
[*]Removed the Repair Malfunction event[/list][/list]

[b]Miscellaneous Notes[/b]
[list][*]Help text has been added to the Multiplayer Queue window explaining that players can participate in Solo Modes whilst waiting for an opponent in Multiplayer Queue
[*]An ‘Enable Intro Cinematic’ option has been added to the Gameplay Tab of the Options Menu
[*]Players can now watch Infestation replays (WIP)
[*]Players now have the option to “like” replays
[*]There is now a search bar in the filter, allowing players to search for specific replays using their Match Code. (Match Codes can be found by selecting a replay – the code is listed under the Watch Match button)
[*]Non-critical and user-input VO is now gated by a 10 second timer to avoid excessive VO triggers[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the right dropship in a replay would show the incorrect team until the countdown timer started
[*]Fixed an issue where the Options Menu could not be closed if the player hit Esc while the resign confirmation pop up was open
[*]Fixed an issue where the Watch Menu was displaying Rigs default loadouts rather than the selected loadout
[*]Fixed an issue where the speed control bar in the Replay Controls did not scale to 16x FF
[*]Fixed an issue where Jovians earned from Level Ups and Daily Bounties were not counting toward the ‘Kingpin’ achievement
[*]Fixed another issue regarding bad texture states when navigating between the Player Menu and the Builder Menu
[*]Fixed an issue where Atomic Welder was doing damage to allied units
[*]Fixed a very rare UI related crash
[*]Fixed an issue where certain FX lights were using the wrong quality settings
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur if Plutus casted Paradigm Shift on a Tank that was using Palm Rockets on a Vision Tower or Uplink
[*]Fixed an issue where Friends Lists information would overlap if enough friends were in a sort listing to produce a scroll bar
[*]Fixed an issue where some players were receiving ‘Unable to connect to the internet. Error Type: 2, Error Code:60’ when attempting to launch Dropzone
[*]Fixed an issue where Dropzone would not launch if it failed to initialize the default audio device. Now, if Dropzone fails to initialize the default audio device, it will launch with no sound and display an error message[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking observers slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast – fix incoming soon
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Global Chat does not reflect your changed name until you have restarted the game[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to Dropzone!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/4019cef57728c0c74ddac64c05d31d1fa06c6ff9.png[/img]
The day has arrived: Dropzone is now in Early Access! All of us here at Sparkypants Studios are really excited to be getting the game into your hands, and we can't wait to hear what you think. 

Over the past few months, we've been working alongside our Closed Beta testers to polish core gameplay, iterate on new features, and squash bugs; and today we're thrilled to involve more players in the development of Dropzone through Early Access.

For all new Commanders just joining us, welcome! To help you prepare for your first Core-hunting missions on Europa, here are a few tips:
[list][*]Be sure to run through the tutorial! It'll teach you everything you need to know about how to play Dropzone.
[*]Dropzone has a replay system that allows you to watch matches featuring other players! Click on the WATCH tab in the menu to browse through recently-played games. It's a helpful way to pick up some new tactics. You can even watch your own replays (easily located in your Profile > Match History) to see what your opponent did during the match!
[*]Dropzone is all about customizing your squad of three Rigs and their Gear. From the BUILD menu, you can test your squad's abilities before you bring them into battle against human or AI opponents.[/list]

After you've gotten a few drops under your belt, we'd love to hear your thoughts here on the Steam forums. At Sparkypants, collaborating with our players is a big part of what we do, and your feedback helps to improve Dropzone. We're also big believers in keeping our players informed about the direction we're planning to take with Dropzone, so today we'd like to share with you our development Roadmap. This isn't an exhaustive list of all the things we want to add to the game during Early Access (and YOU, our players, might come up with some cool ideas we'll want to incorporate in the future), but it's high priority stuff we're working on. In the coming months, you can expect to see:
[list][*]Ranked Play mode, for players who want to test their skills in a division format. If you click on the Ranked Play tab (in the Versus menu), you can see an overview of what we have planned for our ranking system.
[*]An ad-hoc tournament system for creating and competing in short daily tournaments .
[*]Additional Infestation and PvE content.
[*]A brand new 5th class, including three new Pilots and 24 new pieces of class-specific gear.
[*]A new Season of Gear!
[*]More pilots!
[*]More maps![/list]

As we roll out new updates to Dropzone, we'll dicsuss them with you and listen to your input. If you have suggestions, run across issues, or just want to share your thoughts on the game, be sure to let us know in the forums!

Now get out there and grab some Cores, Commander!

notes.title: Patch Notes Open Beta v1635
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list][*]New Game Mode: Infestation (WIP)
[list][*]This new Co-Op mode supports one to four players, and the objective is for all players to defend the reactor for as long as possible
[*]The rules of this mode can be accessed by clicking the ‘Rules’ button displayed on Infestation Custom lobby menus
[*]Upload Cores and destroy Kavash to increase the team's score, and the team's rewards
[*]Protect the Reactor to maintain power to the Uplinks. Once the Uplinks are offline the mission is over
[*]The Kavash grow stronger with every wave. Destroyed Hives will drop Cores, but will also add events to future waves. Everything comes with a price
[*]Squad levels are earned by uploading Cores; keep those Uplinks busy!
[*]Rigs will not respawn automatically, so stay aware of your squad's health
[*]Spread across the map are powerups, automated defenses, and a healing zone to aid in your battles. Keep the score climbing and hold out as long as you can![/list][/list]
[list][*]Builder 2.0
[list][*]Builder view has been completely reworked!
[*]Players can now build their full 3-Rig squad in the same menu
[*]Pressing 1 2 and 3 will rotate the dropship to change the selected Rig, or the player can just select a Rig to change it
[*]Pressing Q W E and R will activate each Rig’s currently selected gear and play the appropriate active animations so you can preview each gear
[*]Animated Pilot portraits are displayed on the left side, for each Rig on which you click. Clicking this portrait will open the Pilot list, the player can also click the Rig in the builder to open the Pilot list
[*]There are options listed below the animated portraits, including ‘Alter Ego’, ‘Details’ and ‘Reset Gear’
[*]The ‘Test Loadout’ button has been changed to ‘Test Squad’ – this button is located in the right corner of the builder, next to the ‘Save Squad’ button
[*]Loadouts are now Squad-based! Think of your squad as a cohesive unit with complimentary gear, and save that loadout for whatever style of play you're looking to achieve. Up to 3 Squad Loadouts can be saved at a time and gear can be shared across saves[/list][/list]
[list][*]Sandbox Mode (‘Test Squad’)
[list][*]Now supports all 3 Rigs loaded in at the same time![/list][/list]
[h1]Pilot Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Turbine’s Special Move: ‘Stoke the Fire’
[list][*]Now deals a fixed 440 damage to Turbine over the course of the ability's 10 second duration[/list][/list]
[h1]Gameplay Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Triple Tank AI Teams have been moved to Medium AI difficulty
[*]2v2 AI difficulty is now set to Expert
[*]Boss Minions now have a higher selection priority for right-click attacks than Bosses
[*]Units will now initiate their casting much closer to their maximum cast range, instead of pathing unnecessarily close
[*]The Drafting Sequence has been updated
[list][*]Draft Background scene has been updated
[*]Dropship animations have been updated
[*]The Draft Sequence will now pick the last Squad Loadout that was active in the Builder[/list][/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous Notes[/h1]
[list][*]Dropzone now supports multiple languages, including: German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Polish, Turkish, and Portuguese
[*]Players will be required to set their account name when they log in for the first time. This is to ensure a smooth transition for Closed Beta accounts linking to Steam
[*]Revised the matchmaking algorithm to better prioritize opponent skill when selecting a match
[*]A ‘PLAY’ button is now located within all menus except the Options Menu and the Train Menu, allowing the player to easily enter the Play Menu from multiple areas of the game 
[*]The Play Menu has updated and now includes the following options
[list][*]Quick Match: Places the player in Multiplayer Queue
[*]Versus: Opens a Menu with Versus AI, 2v2, Ranked Play (Coming Soon) and Tournaments (Coming Soon) – Versus AI will allow a player to select an AI difficulty and start an AI match, and 2v2 will open the Custom Lobby menu with 2v2 options automatically set
[*]Infestation (New Mode!): Leads to Solo Infestation and Co-Op Infestation – Solo Infestation will immediately start a Solo Infestation game, and Co-Op Infestation will open the Custom Lobby menu with Infestation options automatically set 
[*]Custom: Opens the Custom Lobby Menu[/list][/list]
[list][*]The Watch Menu has updated (WIP)
[list][*]Now features a new UI design with loadouts used, the map the match was played on and Map Objectives
[*]The player can now sort the replay list for 1v1 matches and 2v2 matches
[*]A list of each replay is located on the right side of the graph, and clicking a replay will open a more detailed list of the match on the left side – the player can then choose to watch the chose by clicking the ‘Watch Match’ button located under the match details
[*]A Match Spoilers option has been added, and enabling it will reveal the final score of the match, as well as which player(s) completed each Map Objective  
[*]Hovering over the gear or pilots in the match details screen will now show gear and pilot hover cards [/list][/list]
[list][*]An Intro video has been added that plays when the game is launched
[list][*]Clicking the screen or pressing the spacebar will show a ‘Skip Intro’ button above the intro video
[*]If the player doesn’t move the mouse for 5 seconds, the ‘Skip Intro’ button will be hidden[/list][/list]
[list][*]Main Menu scene has been updated and now features the dropship within a hanger – the dropship will fly out of the hanger when entering draft sequences 
[*]A credits list has been added to the Options Menu
[*]Palm Rockets now has a chain FX
[*]Crazed Banshee’s ammo size has increased and the FX and animations have been updated to make it more visible
[*]Capacity Overload now uses the same targeting decal as Laser Lens
[*]Surge Amplifier now uses the same targeting decal as Laser Lens
[*]Various gear FX has been updated
[*]Various gear icon art has been updated
[*]Font styles have been updated
[*]A lighting pass has been done on all maps, and lighting has been improved with High Quality materials turned off
[*]A profanity chat filter option has been added to the Interface tab of the Options Menu
[*]Global Chat now plays SFX when new messages are sent
[*]There is an option to turn off the Global Chat SFX located in the Interface Tab of the Options Menu
[*]Replays can now be fast forwarded up to 16x
[*]Team and Player colors are now consistent in all modes. 2v2 renders both blue players as blue, instead of one as green in observer mode	
[*]New gear cards in the Builder now say ‘NEW’ instead of ‘!’
[*]New Blueprints in the Crafting Menu now say ‘NEW’ instead of ‘!’
[*]New Player Portraits are available
[*]Daily Bounties are now available as Transmissions
[*]Game update messages (Level up events, tower captures, etc) have been removed from the Onboarding missions
[*]Custom Vision Tower preview pictures have been updated[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where Turbine’s Glob Launcher was using Acid Cannon’s FX in the Builder
[*]Fixed an issue where Turbine’s Glob Launcher was not correctly playing its projectile FX in game
[*]Fixed an issue where the length of the match history list would change depending on the number of games displayed on the page
[*]Fixed an issue where chat options were not scaled correctly on 4k resolution
[*]Fixed an issue where Turbine’s Special Move ‘Stoke the Fire’ was dealing more damage to Turbine than intended
[*]Fixed an issue where Rigs with two identical software slots could equip a default software in one slot and the same non-default software in the other slot 
[*]Fixed an issue where chats were not auto-scrolling properly
[*]Fixed an issue where the ‘First Blood’ objective reward was listed as ‘1 points’
[*]Fixed an issue where players could not attempt to re-enter a password protected lobby if they closed the ‘Enter Password’ pop up
[*]Fixed an issue where Pulverizers auto-attack SFX would stop playing properly when overridden by other SFX[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]There are known issues with words bleeding outside of their bounding boxes for every language other than English. Fixes are on the way
[*]Locking observers slots in Custom Matches only works when both slots are empty
[*]The Private Match setting only works when the game is already created, so someone can join in-between
[*]Hive Link does not have a cast ring around hives to show where the ability can be cast – fix incoming soon
[*]The ‘Easy Pickings’ achievement does not count Hives killed by a teammate towards the goal
[*]Jovians earned in Daily Bounties and Level Ups do not count toward the ‘Kingpin’ achievement[/list]

notes.title: Steam Bundles revealed!
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders! Today we're excited to announce we will be offering two Dropzone Early Access bundles this February!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/b6bf4286f9d1e47e414d1855bdd68884555fc8fb.png[/img]

[h1]The COMMANDER Edition: $39.99 / 39.99€[/h1]
The Commander Edition includes all 12 pilots available at launch, plus EVERY PILOT that will be released in the future! The Commander Edition bundle comes with all 120 current pieces of unique gear, and the next 120 upcoming pieces of gear!

In this Bundle you will also receive two exclusive digital items:
[list] [*]The official Dropzone digital soundtrack by Grant Kirkhope!
[*]"The Art of Dropzone" digital PDF artbook, with 100 pages of art from the game! [/list]
And that's not all! It also contains the following in-game bonuses:
[list] [*]Two exclusive Early Access portraits!
[*]Two exclusive Early Access Vision Tower icons!
[*]Three exclusive Alter Egos: unique versions of our pilots with different costumes and alternate gear loadouts![/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27512272/9dda006cfe98b1be80a13e62afd3417b67618330.png[/img]

[h1]The SQUAD Edition : $19.99/ 19.99€[/h1]
The Squad Edition includes all 12 pilots released to date in the game, and will include 3 new pilots for an as-yet-unannounced class following release. The Squad Edition bundle comes with all 120 current pieces of unique gear, and will include the 24 pieces corresponding to the new class!

You will also receive:
[list][*]One exclusive Early Access portrait!
[*]One exclusive Early Access Vision Tower icon!
[*]One exclusive Alter Ego: Daredevil Recon![/list]
Choose your Bundle and join the core hunt, Commanders!
